Creative Technologist

TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What you'll do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

  • Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)

  • Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it

  • Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time

  • Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets

  • Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What we're looking for

  • Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software

  • Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user; you’ve built something with these APIs, even if only for yourself

  • Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems

  • Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste

  • Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on

  • You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

Nice to have

  • Experience with Lovable or similar AI-native building tools

  • Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling

  • Portfolio or side projects that show both craft and curiosity

Our tech stack

Lovable is built with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React, Tailwind

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next, especially in image/video generation APIs and pipelines. You’ll build custom tools in chorus with Lovable, while also contributing to Lovable upstream.

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

  2. Show us some of your work you're really proud of.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English. It's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

  • We are prioritizing candidates who are based in London or Stockholm, or those willing to relocate.

  • We treat all candidates equally and if you're interested please apply through our careers portal.

jobs.title: People Tech & Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
People Tech & Analytics Lead

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a People Tech & Analytics Lead on the People team, you will turn people data into better decisions at Mistral. You will own the roadmap for our HR technology stack, from the HRIS transformation to integrations and data architecture, and build the analytics, dashboards and models that help our leaders understand how we hire, grow, retain and reward our people, and act on what they learn.

You will do it the Mistral way: automating people processes with our own models, workflows and agents, and partnering with HR Operations, Business Partnering, Legal, Finance and IT to turn business needs into well-designed systems.

You will lead a small team, starting with a People Tech & Analytics Engineer, alongside a large team of agents running our back-end HR processes, giving a fast-growing global company the clarity to make great people decisions at speed, with a seamless employee experience from hire to retire.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own the people-tech roadmap and the HR tech stack end to end: what we build, buy, integrate or retire, the configuration standards, workflows, roles and permissions that govern it, vendor relationships, and the data pipelines across HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity and finance so data flows reliably between systems.

  • Define the people metrics that matter and lead analysis on workforce trends, retention and organisational health, turning insight into clear recommendations and workforce planning.

  • Oversee dashboards, self-serve reporting and conversational insights, so managers get answers without waiting on a spreadsheet.

  • Drive people-data governance, partnering with Legal and Privacy to keep people data compliant and AI use on it lawful, transparent and proportionate.

  • Own the automation and AI roadmap for people processes: build agents and workflows with Mistral's own models and APIs, set the standards for how they're designed, tested and monitored, and lead cross-functional projects from scoping to rollout.

  • Manage and mentor the People Tech & Analytics Engineer, set priorities, and grow the team as needs evolve.

     

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience in HR technology and people analytics, ideally in a high-growth tech company: expert in at least one, broad in both, and comfortable building from scratch.

  • A strong product mindset: you turn complex business and employee needs into intuitive, practical solutions, starting from the HR need, not the technology.

  • Experience with global HR tech platforms such as HiBob, Deel or Rippling, and the integrations, data architecture and governance connecting them to ATS, payroll, identity and finance.

  • Strong workflow-automation experience (n8n or similar) and a real appetite to build with our own LLMs, agents and APIs, with the judgement to know where AI helps and where it doesn't.

  • Solid analytics foundations (forecasting, visualisation, modern data stack such as Snowflake or BigQuery), experience building people analytics and data governance on workforce data, and working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to employee data.

  • Experience presenting to senior leaders, turning data into clear, decision-ready recommendations, and managing or mentoring technical or analytical team members, with the hands-on pragmatism to prototype and review technical work yourself.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

  • You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

  • Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

  • Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

  • You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

  • Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

  • Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

  • Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

  • Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

  • Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

Logistics

  • Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich.

  • Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

  • Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)

Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien

  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

jobs.title: Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau
jobs.description:
Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau

Wil jij impact maken aan de voorkant van onze uitdagende bouwprojecten? Heb je ruime technische kennis. Heb jij affiniteit met planning en prijsvorming? Dan is dit jouw kans om als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau het verschil te maken!

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan:

·       Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek.

·       Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject)

·       Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten

·       Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit)

·       Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers.

·       Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen.

·       Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen.

Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten.

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen.

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken!


Dit breng je mee

·       Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of als bouwtechnoloog/projectorganisator.

·       Je hebt een afgeronde bouwkundige opleiding.

·       Je hebt ervaring met Asta powerproject en Revit.

·       Je hebt technisch inzicht en werkt gestructureerd.

·       Je kan goed samenwerken, neemt initiatief en denkt een stap vooruit.

·       Jij staat voor jouw oplossingen en kan deze mondeling goed toelichten aan o.a. uitvoering.

·       Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en bent stressbestendig

Deze punten geven een beeld van het profiel dat wij zoeken. Herken jij jezelf niet volledig in alle punten, maar denk je wel dat deze functie bij je past? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Dit bieden wij jou

Brand Management Stage (vanaf januari 2027)

Misschien wel het leukste bedrijf van Nederland is op zoek naar versterking! Dit prachtige familiebedrijf groeit als kool en daarom zijn wij hard op zoek naar marketing talent. Word jij enthousiast van grote brands? Ben je benieuwd hoe deze internationaal worden gepositioneerd en houd jij van design? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Binnen het brand management team zijn wij op zoek naar een Brand Management stagiair(e). Als Brand Management stagiair(e) draai je gewoon mee met het team. Dit betekent dat je een lekker veelzijdige baan hebt met veel verantwoordelijkheden. Je helpt ons met het ontwikkelen van diverse brand campagnes, van idee tot shoot en van lancering tot evaluatie. Daarnaast bewaak en versterk je de merk identiteit (in meer dan 85 landen!), dit doe je door veel te schakelen met andere afdelingen binnen KEUNE.

Btw, koffie halen en printen kunnen we zelf, daar ben jij niet voor. We vinden het veel belangrijker dat je je stem laat horen en ons omver blaast met je kennis van de beauty-industrie, je goede ideeën en je slimme vragen.

We staan open voor zowel meewerkstagiairs als afstudeerders. In overleg formuleren we een passende onderzoeksvraag waarmee jij kunt afstuderen, mits je minimaal 4 dagen in de week meewerkt.

YOU

  • Je volgt een relevante opleiding op HBO/WO niveau;

  • Spreekt en schrijft flawless Nederlands en Engels;

  • Begrijpt wat het inhoudt om onderdeel van een team te zijn;

  • Gaat niet zitten wachten tot er dingen gebeuren of iemand iets van je vraagt, maar toont initiatief;

  • Bent flexibel en kunt goed omgaan met last minute veranderingen;

  • Bent grappig (het is ook ok als je dat alleen zelf vindt).



OUR OFFER

  • Collega’s die elkaar behandelen als familie;

  • Een B Corp gecertificeerde werkgever;

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving;

  • Collega’s die investeren in jouw talent;

  • De mogelijkheid om een scriptie te schrijven of onderzoek te doen;

  • De kans om samen te werken met top notch marketeers;

  • Regelmatig (eerlijke!) feedback;

  • Stagevergoeding van €650,- per maand;

KEUNE

We zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap centraal staat in alles wat we doen. Ons verhaal begint in 1922, in Amsterdam. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Soest worden KEUNE-producten ontwikkeld, geproduceerd en wereldwijd gedistribueerd naar meer dan 85 landen. En we zijn niet van plan om gas terug te nemen! Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us build powerful, delightful features that empower restaurant teams. You’ll work across the stack to bring new ideas to life, whether it’s building intuitive interfaces, scalable backend services, or the glue in between that makes everything feel seamless.

You’ll collaborate closely with design, product, and other engineers to rapidly ship impactful features. As an early team member, you’ll also help shape our engineering culture, tooling, and technical direction.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving real user problems, and wants to help modernize an underserved industry with thoughtful, elegant software.

Responsibilities:

  • Build, test, and ship end-to-end features across the stack—from APIs and data models.

jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | UK | Remote

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

.

Hiring and how we work

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Security Engineer, Incident Response

About the job

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) is looking for a Security Engineer who is passionate about solving Twilio’s mission of security and reliability by working across the organization to lead the technical response to security events and incidents across Twilio’s global infrastructure, services and applications by effectively conducting triage, containment, remediation and driving post-incident betterments. You will work within a team that partners with R&D Engineering and R&D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions.

You will be a valued member of a team of deeply technical Security Engineers to focus on creating bespoke and standard Security response processes, enhancing our capabilities for threat mitigation and incident response, and then automating as much as you possibly can (and more)! You will help us to grow our global, scaled team and program.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead and support the response to all security events and incidents across Twilio’s complex global infrastructure, services and applications.
  • Be responsible for documentation of incidents and projects you work on and craft best practices as runbooks and standard operating procedures to share knowledge across teams.
  • Work cross-collaboratively to understand and help solve challenges related to a broad spectrum of threat actors and activity.
  • Work to improve Twilio’s security and reliability posture by driving identified betterments from security events and incidents.
  • Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, highly disruptive industry environment.
  • Own the security incident lifecycle, respond to incidents and participate in on-call rotation and participate in RCAs for security incidents.
  • Build, cultivate, and maintain positive relationships with internal customers to identify and facilitate solutions to increase the impact of the team’s work.
  • Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • Proven experience: 3+ years of security incident response in a production-cloud environment
  • Subject-matter expert on security issues and technologies
  • Ability to utilize AI for comprehensive, complex security incident response activities delivering high fidelity detections
  • Advanced knowledge of service-oriented architectures, as well as experience with security tools and technologies fit for a cloud environment
  • Experience working across a technology stack on difficult security challenges and initiatives
  • Experience with SIEM platforms and the ability to extend their functionality
  • Experience with SOAR tools and automating manual security processes

  • AI-Driven Threat Response: Utilize GenAI and LLM-based security use cases to rapidly interpret alerts, reduce false positives, and contextualize threat data
  • Artifact & Evidence Triage: Collects intrusion artifacts and forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Monitors external vendor data and threat intelligence to analyze trends and proactively defend against emerging risks.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland or U.K.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

jobs.title: (Senior) Enterprise Engagement Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
(Senior) Enterprise Engagement Manager (f/m/d)

About Stackgini

How do you govern 20,000 applications when nobody in the building still knows which of them do the same thing? How do you get faster to market and leaner at the same time, when business units ship AI prototypes in days and the regulatory load grows every quarter?

Stackgini is the AI operating system for Autonomous Enterprise IT. Our system understands our customers' enterprise tech landscape from the ground up: from technical configuration to application documentation, from a single tech demand to the dependencies across the entire portfolio. With the depth of knowledge of a senior tech expert and the speed of a machine. Some of the largest organizations in the world work with us, including DAX-40 and Fortune-500 customers like Siemens Healthineers and REWE.

We're a small, talent-dense team, building what we believe will change how the world's largest companies operate. We are growing fast, and the people joining now are the ones who set the standard - for the product, the culture, and our category. Stackgini will be the place where you will do the most meaningful work of your career.

About the role

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you own what Stackgini actually becomes inside our customers. You take over once the deal closes and guide the organization from the first target-picture discussion to the point where tech demand management runs differently than it did before.

This is advisory work with a product behind it. You sit with CIOs, IT business partners, and enterprise architects, understand how their demand process works today and where it breaks, and design a target picture they can defend internally. You measure what it delivered and turn that into the basis for the next year.

Unlike consulting, you don't walk out after the final presentation. You stay with the accounts you own and see, over years, what became of your work.

Areas of ownership

  • Strategic advisory. You are the trusted advisor to tech leaders in DAX-40, Fortune-500, and ambitious mid-market organizations. You show them what best-practice AI-first demand management looks like and bring an outside view they can't get internally. Out of that you develop the target picture with them, from the end-to-end process concept to how Stackgini fits into the existing IT toolchain.

  • Value realization. You define the KPIs you will be measured against together with the customer, baseline them, and prove the effect. You guide them through portfolio optimization and build the business cases behind it. Realized value is not a story for the QBR here, it is the number the role hangs on.

  • Stakeholder engagement. You make the champions inside the customer's organization successful. You give them the arguments, the evidence, and the backing they need to carry Stackgini into business units, IT governance, architecture, procurement, and information security.

  • Adoption and enablement. You make power users and multipliers capable through trainings, best practices, and workshops, and you feed what you learn back into our methodology.

  • Account growth and expansion. Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and units, and spot risk before it surfaces in a renewal.

  • Build our customer value engine. You work hands-on on daily operations, expand the Stackgini Academy into a best-in-class enablement hub, and develop thought leadership assets: playbooks, point-of-view content, best practice guides.

  • Partner cross-functionally. Bring structured customer insights into Product and Engineering, shape our roadmap with use-case-driven evidence, and support Sales on key strategic deals.

Who you are

  • 2+ years in enterprise tech or consulting. Strategy or management consulting, IT transformation, or an enterprise tech function such as IT governance, architecture, or tech demand management. What matters is that you owned an outcome at a customer, not a workstream.

  • You structure ambiguity. You break down complex problems, shape them into clear options, and build processes that work without you.

  • You hold your own up to C-level. Precise in writing, structured in speech, composed in front of executives. In German and English.

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. You can describe concretely how you use LLMs, agents, or custom workflows in your daily work. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be credible in a room with one.

  • Ownership over scope. You move things forward without waiting to be assigned, and client-facing work energizes you rather than drains you.

What's a plus

  • A real understanding of how enterprise tech organizations work, ideally with exposure to enterprise architecture, IT governance, software asset management, or IT procurement

  • Experience designing onboarding paths, trainings, and certifications that drive adoption at scale

Your first 90 days

  • You own accounts and know their demand process well enough to challenge it.

  • You have built a target picture and the corresponding value KPIs with at least one customer.

  • You run workshops and trainings on your own, with business and tech in the same room.

  • You have improved one thing about our methodology, because you saw where it didn't hold up at a customer.

Process

Intro call, hiring manager interview, case study, meeting the team.

Compensation Package

The annual salary for this permanent, full-time position is EUR 80,000–110,000 per year and employee stock options.

Benefits

  • Opportunities for professional growth

  • 30 days of vacation and day off on your birthday

  • Modern office space in Berlin

  • Budget for self-improvement, and other perks

  • Gympass

  • Deutschlandticket subscription

  • Dedicated time for learning & innovation

  • Quarterly Get-Together-Events

  • The best popcorn in town

Ready to make an impact? Join us at Stackgini and be part of something extraordinary!

jobs.description:
Business Advisor Enterprise DACH (m/w/d)

Odoo entwickelt eine Suite von Open-Source-Betriebsanwendungen, die von CRM und E-Commerce bis hin zu Buchhaltung, Lager und Projektmanagement alle Bedürfnisse eines Unternehmens abdeckt. Das Ziel ist es, einer der weltweit führenden Open-Source-Anbieter zu sein und Software bereitzustellen, die gleichzeitig sehr einfach zu bedienen und voll integriert ist.

Als Business Advisor Enterprise übernimmst du die strategische Begleitung der digitalen Transformation von mittelständischen Unternehmen und Konzernen im DACH-Raum. Dabei arbeitest du unternehmerisch – von der ersten Analyse bis zum finalen Abschluss – und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf. 🤝

Es ist eine Rolle, die neben der Verantwortung des gesamten End-to-End Sales Cycles viel Beratung und Strategie verlangt - und das ohne lästige Kaltakquise.

  • Du bist Sparringspartner:in für C-Level-Entscheider:innen und unterstützt sie bei ihrer digitalen Transformation.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Business Analyst:innen zusammen - sowohl im Pre-Sales, um spezifische Lösungen zu erarbeiten, als auch während der Implementierungsphase in Steering Committees.

  • Vertrauen und Enthusiasmus schaffen - du steckst andere mit deiner Begeisterung für unsere Software an

Warum Odoo?

Langweilige 0815 Jobs, mit komplizierten Entscheidungswegen, starren Hierarchien und Micromanaging sind nicht so dein Ding? Cool, unser auch nicht!

Bei uns wirst du in einer offenen Atmosphäre arbeiten, in der du die Freiheit hast, deine Ideen zu verwirklichen. Garantiert unkompliziert! 😌

Außerdem ist unser Produkt natürlich super cool und generiert einen wirklichen Mehrwert für unsere Kund:innen.

  • BVG-Ticket : Damit du einfach von A nach B kommst.

Teamlead Customer Support & Sales (m/w/d)

Du machst aus unserem Support ein Team, das Kund:innen hält und gewinnt

Bei eRecht24 melden sich jeden Tag Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops und Agenturen: per Ticket, per Telefon, mit Fragen zu Tarifen, Rechnungen und Rechtstexten. Hinter vielen dieser Anfragen steckt mehr als ein Supportfall: ein Upgrade, das hilft, eine Kündigung, die sich abwenden lässt, eine Agentur, die zwanzig Kundenprojekte im kleinsten Tarif verwaltet.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die unser Customer-Support-Team führt, den Betrieb stabil und messbar macht und daraus Schritt für Schritt eine Kundenberatung mit Vertriebsblick aufbaut. Du führst, du planst, und du bist selbst am Telefon.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise).

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen und professionalisiert sich gerade: neue Rollen in Marketing, Product und Data, ein Data Warehouse, klarere Prozesse. Im Support sind die Werkzeuge da, ein modernes Ticketsystem und eine voll funktionsfähige Telefonanlage. Der Support betreut inzwischen die gesamte Unternehmensgruppe. Was fehlt, ist eine Führung, die daraus ein belastbares System macht.

Deine Aufgaben

Team führen und Betrieb steuern

  • Du führst das Customer-Support-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, arbeitest Mitarbeitende ein und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Du planst Einsätze, Urlaube und Vertretungen und sorgst dafür, dass wir erreichbar sind und Anfragen zeitnah bearbeitet werden.

  • Du analysierst Kontaktvolumen, Bearbeitungszeiten und Kapazität, erkennst Engpässe früh und begründest, wann wir mehr Leute brauchen.

Qualität, Prozesse und Systeme

  • Du etablierst Service-, Qualitäts- und Dokumentationsstandards, Gesprächsleitfäden und Kennzahlen.

  • Du bewertest unsere Support- und Telefoniesysteme, empfiehlst Verbesserungen und steuerst freigegebene Systemwechsel samt Migration.

Kundenberatung und Sales aufbauen

  • Du baust die telefonische Beratung aus: Inbound und Outbound, Produkt- und Tarifberatung, Unterstützung bei Tarifwechseln, Upselling, das wirklich zum Bedarf passt.

  • Kund:innen zurückgewinnen: Du holst gekündigte und inaktive Kund:innen zurück, verstehst, warum sie gegangen sind, und entwickelst mit dem Marketing die passenden Angebote.

  • Du bindest Kund:innen und beugst Kündigungen vor, gerade bei Business- und Enterprise-Kund:innen und Agenturen.

  • Du spielst Kundenwissen zurück: Wer sind unsere besten Kund:innen, was brauchen sie, woran scheitern sie? Gemeinsam mit Marketing und Product schärfst du so unser Bild der idealen Kund:innen.

So verteilt sich deine Zeit: rund 40 % operativ im Kundenkontakt, davon ein guter Teil am Telefon, 30 % Führung und Kapazitätssteuerung, 30 % Prozesse, Telefonie und Systeme. In der Einarbeitung ist der operative Anteil höher.

Deine ersten Monate

  • Monat 1 bis 3: Produkt, Tarife und Kundenanliegen kennenlernen, das Team übernehmen, Erreichbarkeit stabilisieren, Kapazitäten und Engpässe analysieren.

  • Monat 3 bis 6: Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen etablieren, Telefonberatung strukturiert aufbauen, Systeme bewerten, Personal- und Prozessbedarf ableiten.

  • Danach: Beratung und Sales weiterentwickeln, Reporting aufbauen, Prozesse standardisieren und skalierbar machen.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Support, Customer Success, Inside Sales oder Contact Center, idealerweise bei einem SaaS- oder Abo-Anbieter

  • Erfahrung als Führungskraft eines Support-, Service- oder Inside-Sales-Teams, inklusive Einsatz- und Kapazitätsplanung

  • Du hast Inbound- und Outbound-Telefonie selbst gemacht und aufgebaut und telefonierst gern: erst zuhören, dann beraten

  • Du erkennst Kaufsignale und Einwände und gehst mit beiden souverän um, ohne Rabatt als ersten Reflex

  • Sicher mit Ticket- und Telefoniesystemen; idealerweise hast du schon einmal ein System ausgewählt, eingeführt oder migriert

  • Du arbeitest mit Kennzahlen und kannst Personalbedarf nachvollziehbar begründen

  • Strukturiert, verlässlich, entscheidungsfreudig im Tagesgeschäft

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, in Wort und Schrift. Du berätst unsere Kund:innen am Telefon auf Deutsch

  • Plus: Erfahrung im Aufbau eines Service- oder Beratungsbereichs, mit Retention und Rückgewinnung, mit Agenturen als Kund:innen, Nähe zu Website-Recht oder Datenschutz

Ein bestimmter Abschluss ist nicht nötig. Entscheidend sind Führungserfahrung, Aufbaukompetenz und die Lust, selbst mit anzupacken.

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest selbst über Einsatzplanung, Prioritäten, Standards, Leitfäden und Einarbeitung.

  • Werkzeuge sind da: Ticketsystem, Telefonanlage, Data Warehouse. Du musst nicht bei null anfangen, sondern daraus ein System bauen.

  • Sichtbarer Impact: Jede gerettete Kündigung, jedes passende Upgrade ist messbar und wird gesehen.

  • Kurze Wege: Du berichtest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung und arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Product und IT.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Operative Mitarbeit während unserer Supportzeiten von 9 bis 16 Uhr

  • Fachliche und disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann lass uns sprechen: 15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und ein kurzes Rollenspiel aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welches Team hast du zuletzt geführt (Größe, Aufgabe), und was hast du dort als Erstes verändert?

jobs.title: Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d) - E-Mail-Marketing & Automation
jobs.description:
Senior CRM Manager (m/w/d) - E-Mail-Marketing & Automation

Du baust nicht nur Kampagnen, sondern den Kanal, über den eRecht24 verkauft

Bei uns ist E-Mail kein Begleitkanal, sondern der Kanal, über den aus kostenlosen Nutzer:innen zahlende Kund:innen werden und aus Kund:innen bessere Kund:innen. Wir haben kein klassisches Sales-Team. Was das Marketing nicht konvertiert, konvertiert niemand.

Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die diesen Kanal fachlich verantwortet: Strategie, Segmentierung, Automationen, Trigger, Testing, Zahlen. Hands-on in Brevo, im Austausch mit unserem Data-Team, im Sparring mit Product.

Wer wir sind und wo wir stehen

eRecht24 ist Deutschlands größte Plattform für Rechtssicherheit im Web: Impressum Generator, Datenschutz Generator, Website Scanner und viele weitere Tools, kostenlos im Freemium-Bereich und vollumfänglich in eRecht24 PREMIUM (Basic, Business, Enterprise). Unsere Kund:innen sind Website-Betreiber, Online-Shops, Agenturen und Webdesigner.

Die Firma ist in wenigen Jahren stark gewachsen: viel Freiheit, viel Tempo, einiges noch unaufgeräumt. Brevo läuft, Kampagnen gehen raus, ein Data Warehouse liefert Segmente. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System macht: Lifecycle statt Gießkanne, Trigger statt Kalender, Tests statt Bauchgefühl.

Wie du bei uns arbeitest

Unser Marketing arbeitet in Squads innerhalb eines Marketing-Tribes. Du verantwortest den E-Mail- und CRM-Squad und arbeitest dort eng mit unserer E-Mail-Marketing-Managerin zusammen. Dein wichtigster Sparringspartner ist die Rolle Senior Marketing Manager Customer Journey: Sie orchestriert die Journey über alle Kanäle, du besitzt den E-Mail-Kanal in der Tiefe.

Die Grenze zu Product ist klar: Onboarding- und System-Mails gehören dem Produkt-Team. Du verantwortest die Marketing-Mails, also Konversion, Upsell, Cross-Sell, Retention und Winback, und stimmst Timing und Überschneidungen mit Product ab.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kanalverantwortung: Du entwickelst die CRM- und E-Mail-Strategie für unsere drei Kohorten und setzt sie um: Subscriber zu Freemium, Freemium zu eRecht24 PREMIUM, PREMIUM zu höheren Tarifen und Zusatzprodukten.

  • Automationen und Trigger: Du baust verhaltensbasierte Sequenzen in Brevo für Konversion, Upsell, Retention, Re-Engagement und Re-Permission, gespeist aus Plattform- und Tracking-Daten. Ein Teil dieser Infrastruktur entsteht gerade, zum Beispiel dynamische Angebotsblöcke in Mails, und du gestaltest mit.

  • Segmentierung mit Daten: Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem BI-Team (Data Warehouse auf BigQuery) an Zielgruppen, Selektionen und Ausschlüssen. Du weißt, was du brauchst, und kannst es formulieren, gern auch in SQL.

  • Kampagnen und Copy: Du planst Kampagnen im Jab-Jab-Jab-Punch-Rhythmus (erst Mehrwert, dann Angebot) und in Batches, schreibst mit KI-Unterstützung auf Basis unserer Wording-Guidelines und finalisierst selbst. Fachinhalte kommen aus Legal und Content.

  • Kontaktregeln und Hygiene: Du definierst und setzt durch, wer wann was bekommt, zum Beispiel: Wer gerade in einer Sequenz steckt, bekommt keine Upsell-Mail. Dazu Listenqualität, Double-Opt-in, Einwilligungen, Bounce-Management und ein sauberer Umgang mit Inaktiven. Wir sind der Rechtssicherheits-Anbieter, unsere Mails sind es auch.

  • Testing und Zahlen: A/B-Tests (Betreff, CTA, Timing, Inhalt), Conversion je Kohorte, Umsatzbeitrag von E-Mail. Du verantwortest eine klare Zielzahl, den Umsatzbeitrag aus E-Mail, und berichtest monatlich, was funktioniert und was du deshalb änderst.

  • Schnittstellen: Customer Journey, Performance Marketing, Content, Product und Support.

Was wir nicht von dir erwarten

  • Ads schalten oder Social Media bespielen

  • Fachinhalte von Grund auf schreiben (die kommen aus Legal und Content)

  • Design (Vorlagen und Unterstützung sind da)

  • Personalführung

  • CRM-Administration oder -Customizing (Salesforce, Dynamics, SAP und Co.)

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 5+ Jahre E-Mail-Marketing oder CRM im B2B-, SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld, davon mehrere Jahre mit eigener Kanalverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge mit Lifecycle-Automationen und Segmentierung (Freemium-to-Paid, Upsell, Churn-Prevention), nicht nur Newsletter

  • Sicher in einem Automation-Tool (Brevo, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud); Brevo-Praxis ist ein starkes Plus

  • Datenaffin: SQL-Grundkenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu lernen

  • Conversion-Copywriting auf Deutsch: klar, kurz, ohne Marketing-Sprech. Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch gut

  • Routine mit KI im Workflow und das Urteil, wann das Ergebnis gut genug ist

  • Hands-on-Mindset in einem Umfeld, das sich gerade professionalisiert

  • Plus: Legal-Tech-, Compliance- or Rechtsthemen-Hintergrund, Erfahrung mit CDPs oder Cross-Domain-Tracking, Matomo

Warum sich die Rolle lohnt

  • Der wichtigste Umsatzkanal der Firma liegt bei dir.

  • Daten sind da: BI-Team, Data Warehouse, Plattform-Tracking.

  • Kein Leerlauf: Ein Backlog an Kampagnen-Konzepten wartet auf jemanden, der priorisiert und rausbringt.

  • Kurze Wege zur Marketing-Leitung, zu Product und zur Geschäftsführung.

  • AI-first, organisationsweit und von der Geschäftsführung getragen.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Vollzeit

  • Hybrid in Berlin, drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

  • Keine Personalverantwortung, du berichtest an die Marketing-Leitung

Klingt nach dir?

15 Minuten Kennenlernen, ein einstündiges Fachgespräch, dann Team und eine kleine Aufgabe aus unserem Alltag.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beantworte uns stattdessen in der Bewerbung kurz drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Automation oder Sequenz hast du zuletzt selbst gebaut, und was hat sie in Zahlen gebracht?

  2. Mit welchem Tool arbeitest du heute, und wie groß ist die Liste, die du verantwortest?

  3. Wie entscheidest du, wer eine Mail nicht bekommt?

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Forward Deployed Finance Engineer, Private Credit

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey's Finance Engineering team is the investment-side counterpart to our Legal Engineering team: former investment professionals who bring real deal experience to Harvey's prospects and customers. Forward Deployed Finance Engineers lead discovery, demos, pilots, trainings, onboarding, and custom builds alongside our AEs and CSMs. They translate real investment work into Harvey solutions, serving as the trust layer across the entire customer lifecycle, from the first pilot to the most complex, custom-built workflow.

Finance Engineers work on Harvey Deals, a new product built off of Harvey's acquisition of Benchmark. Harvey Deals is where investment teams run their deals — screening, underwriting, diligence, and committee materials — built in the firm's own templates and formats, with every figure traceable back to the document it came from. Harvey works with 150+ asset management firms and analyzes 178M+ documents each month; the Finance Engineering team is how that capability meets the way deal teams actually work.

Finance Engineers understand how investors think and work, and use that expertise to design, build, and refine solutions that hold up under live deal pressure. In doing so, they don't just drive adoption; they shape Harvey's product roadmap, ensuring every release is grounded in what investment teams actually need. It's a team built to make Harvey the platform investment teams can trust with their most important work.

This role is the first Finance Engineer dedicated to private credit. You will build the credit playbook — demo library, workflow templates, use cases — while running live pilots, and lead the credit practice as the team grows.

You may be asked to travel around 2–3+ times per month. Travel is always for a significant business need and typically is for 1–3 days at a time.

What You'll Do

Forward Deployed Finance Engineers on the private credit team are former credit investors who left the desk to help build the future of how credit gets underwritten. Working closely with Account Executives, they engage with direct lenders, opportunistic and specialty finance managers, BDC managers, and insurer credit arms throughout the pre-sales process and stay with them well past it — leading pilots on live opportunities, guiding lenders through what's possible with AI, and sitting down with credit teams to build screening, underwriting, and credit committee workflows in the firm's own templates and formats.

The work is the work they did on the desk: lender presentation and CIM review; QoE read-throughs and data pack analysis; cash flow and leverage modeling; sizing and structuring; covenant and credit agreement review; credit memo drafting; and comps. It continues post-close into compliance certificate review, covenant tracking, amendment and waiver analysis, and quarterly portfolio reporting, so value compounds after the first deal. Along the way, Finance Engineers bring credit-team feedback back into the product, helping shape the future of Harvey.

What You Have

  • 6+ years on the investment or underwriting team at a direct lender, private credit fund, BDC manager, or insurer private credit arm, with demonstrated ownership of live deal work: screening, underwriting, diligence workstreams, modeling, structuring, and drafting credit committee materials. Asset-based and specialty finance backgrounds are welcome. Leveraged finance, restructuring advisory, or rating-agency experience before the principal side is welcome, but principal-side deal execution is required.

  • Strong command of the documents and data that drive a credit decision — lender presentation and CIM, QoE and data pack, model, credit agreement and intercreditor, compliance certificates — and an instinct for where the numbers and the paper disagree.

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling, comfort with prompting and agentic AI workflows, and a builder's instinct for turning a repeated manual process into a repeatable automation. Python, SQL, or experience building internal tools is a plus.

  • Executive presence and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility from analysts and associates through to partners and credit committee members.

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills — comfortable leading a live demo, facilitating a workshop, or holding your own in a technical conversation about a covenant package or an underwriting assumption.

  • Deep curiosity about AI's potential to transform investment work, paired with a practical, solutions-oriented mindset and bias toward action.

  • Track record partnering with senior stakeholders to drive results, with curiosity for testing approaches and optimizing for customer outcomes.

  • Customer-facing or commercial experience (LP or investor relations, capital formation, banking coverage, business development) and/or hands-on experience using AI tools in an investment setting are pluses.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a [job title], we received a total of XXX applications but only XX were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

jobs.title: Finance & BizOps, Marketing
jobs.description:
Finance & BizOps, Marketing

TL;DR: Be the strategic finance partner to the Marketing Org. You will own the financial architecture behind every marketing dollar. You’ll build the models, measurement systems, and operating rhythms that ensure every investment compounds into growth. This is an ownership seat with direct executive visibility, not a reporting function.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What We’re Looking For

Growth marketing strategist: You treat marketing spend as a portfolio of investments, not a cost center. You can decompose a blended CAC, trace attribution across channels, build cohort-level payback models, and tell a CMO exactly where the next marginal dollar should go and where to cut. You have an informed opinion on how brand spend, paid acquisition, and organic loops interact, and you back it with data.

Technical and data-driven: Strong analytical skills, with expert Excel modeling skills as table stakes. Comfortable with data (SQL, HEX, BI tools, or equivalent). You use AI tools and agents to automate work and move faster. Preference for technical degrees or deep technical exposure.

Service-first partner: You bring a proactive, "can-do" attitude to every interaction and own the operationally tedious work required for clean handoffs between teams.

High-slope learner: You learn faster than anyone around you, take ownership immediately, and thrive in low-structure environments. You go from 0→1 and then 1→10.

Experience: 4+ years of relevant experience supporting Marketing leadership. Strong candidates have a foundation in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or management consulting, combined with operational experience at a high-growth startup, AI company, or scaled technology company. You learn fast, take ownership, and operate well in environments where the playbook doesn't exist yet. Bachelor's degree required.

What You’ll Do

Drive marketing efficiency & planning: Own the financial operating plan for Marketing - budget allocation, campaign ROI analysis, and investment tradeoffs to fuel B2C growth while maintaining unit economics discipline.

Build and own channel-level unit economics: Develop and own the CAC, LTV, and payback models that drive investment decisions at the channel and cohort level. Tie spend to acquisition, retention, and revenue so that marketing leadership and finance are operating from one shared source of truth. Pressure-test assumptions continuously — what's working, what's not, and where the next dollar should go.

Connect marketing performance to company outcomes: Work across the organization to ensure marketing investment ties to measurable business results. Analyze market trends, competitive spend, and channel dynamics to inform forward-looking strategy and ensure capital is deployed where it compounds.

Support experimentation, reporting, and forecasting: Partner with Marketing to size tests, set success metrics, and forecast impact on growth and unit economics. Create clear, repeatable reporting to track performance, targets, variance, and learnings that translate into action.

Accelerate with AI: Use AI agents and automation to collapse the time between question and answer. You're expected to continuously push what's possible, replacing manual processes with scalable infrastructure that moves at Lovable's speed.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
