jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech

Senior Backend Engineer - Introducer Tech - DE

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer

You'll own the Lending API in Germany, which banks, fintechs, brokers, and comparison sites build on to offer iwoca's finance to their customers. You'll decide how it evolves and help build the features that make partners choose iwoca.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Introducer Tech builds the systems that partners in Germany use to refer businesses to iwoca. The aim is to get new partners integrated quickly and to make applying simple for their customers. The team also looks after how partners earn commission.

Its work covers three main areas:

  • The Lending API. Developing the versioned API and the webhooks that keep partners up to date on their customers.

  • The Introducer Portal. Building the web app that German brokers log in to, to submit applications and upload documents.

  • The sign-up journey. Improving how businesses apply and how well they convert, after a partner referral.

The team is growing to have two product managers, who each focus on either the broker or the partner flow, and three engineers across the backend and frontend, including this hire.

The team currently works in sprints, with three stand-ups a week and planning every two weeks. However, there is room to adapt how it works as it grows.

The role

You'll be the senior engineer behind iwoca's broker and partner channels in Germany, from the tools partners integrate with to the internal systems that broker account managers use.

Ownership and autonomy

  • Own the Lending API in Germany end to end, deciding what to build, when to release a new version, when to retire an old one, and what iwoca can promise partners.

  • Own the developer portal and every tool partners use to integrate, from documentation that their developers and coding agents can build from to self-serve testing that needs no help from iwoca.

Impact

  • Ship the features that make partners choose iwoca, starting with pre-qualification, which shows a customer what they could borrow before they apply.

  • Make integration quick and simple, so a partner can go live with few questions and little hand-holding.

  • Automate parts of the broker funnel and the internal CRM that broker account managers use, cutting friction and the lag between a decision and the action that follows, and building agents wherever they help.

Growth trajectory

  • Set the team's technical direction and shape the product and technical roadmap alongside the product manager.

  • Align designs with the UK engineers who share the API, so German requirements shape the design from the start.

  • As well as being hands on, you’ll develop your mentoring and coaching skills. You’ll help lead the team as the most senior engineer.

You'll work with the commercial colleagues who bring in new partners, and join the team's weekly support rotation.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built production backend systems in Python – ideally with Django, though FastAPI or Flask count too. You've used PostgreSQL or another relational database in production, and kept it fast and maintainable.

  • API design. You've built and evolved APIs that other teams or companies depend on, and made the decisions on structure, versioning, and change.

  • Ownership. You've taken work from a commercial problem through to production – scoping the solution, making the trade-offs, and iterating based on how people use it.

  • Mentoring. You've helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Partner onboarding. You've helped external developers integrate with an API – through documentation, test environments, or working with them directly.

  • Full-stack. You've contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • CI/CD. You've set up or maintained the pipelines that test and release a production service.

  • Measurement. You've used data, metrics, or A/B tests to check whether a change had the effect you intended.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer.

You’ll build features on iwoca’s business credit card and own each one from the first line of code to the moment a customer makes their first spend.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds what business owners use to sign up, get their card, and manage it, on the web and in the iwoca Mobile App. It’s cross-functional – engineers collaborate with product and design.

The role

As a senior full-stack engineer, you’ll work mostly on the backend, and build the frontend for your features too.

  • Ownership. You’ll shape what the team builds next, starting from what customers need. You’ll decide how each of your features works, from the data model and API to how you test, release, and monitor it.

  • Impact. Business owners use your work every time they check their cashback, set spend controls, or freeze a lost card. The team releases often, and your changes reach them quickly.

  • Variation. You’ll write Python and FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL, and React and TypeScript for the web. You’ll also work in React Native on the iwoca Mobile App, and on the Credit Cards CRM that operations staff use, when a feature needs it.

  • Card expertise. You’ll learn how card transactions work – from the card processor to the card scheme – alongside the engineers who build iwoca’s payments platform.

  • AI-first engineering. You’ll build with AI coding tools as standard. On the iwoca Mobile App, for example, the team writes a spec for each feature and reviews it before building it with Claude Code.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've built well-tested Python services for customer-facing products, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Data models and APIs. You've designed relational data models, ideally in PostgreSQL, and built and integrated APIs.

  • Frontend. You've written enough React and TypeScript to build and ship customer-facing features.

  • Product ownership. You've taken features from an idea to production and owned them once they were live. You've challenged a plan when it didn't meet a customer need, and offered a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Mobile. You've developed iOS or Android app features, ideally in React Native.

  • Fintech. You've worked on financial products, especially card payments.

  • FastAPI. You've built and run production services with FastAPI.

  • Internal tools. You've written software for operations or support staff.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • Interview welcome pack (TAP)

Senior Sales Director (RVP), Consumer Industries UK&I

Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As RVP, Consumer Industries, you will own and grow UiPath's Consumer Industries business across the UK & Ireland — spanning Retail, Travel & Hospitality, Media and Telecommunications. You will build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales organisation, combining strategic account leadership with new-business growth, to deliver transformational value for our largest and most strategic customers.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Operate in harmony with our values: Humble, Bold, Immersed, and Fast

  • Develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for Consumer Industries across the UK & Ireland, building a sustainable, scalable growth plan aligned to company objectives

  • Build and lead a differentiated sales team spanning strategic account management, enterprise growth and new-business hunting, each with a distinct playbook and clear ownership

  • Grow our largest strategic accounts through executive sponsorship, multi-year account planning and consistent value realisation

  • Expand UiPath's footprint within existing customers by opening new buying centres and driving adoption of new solution areas

  • Lead new-logo acquisition against a clearly defined ideal customer profile, generating and converting a healthy new-business pipeline

  • Communicate and align strategy across UiPath's Eco System of GSI's, Focus Partners, and Technology and Academic alliances to extend customer impact

  • Head up monthly & quarterly business review cadence with account sponsors, to track progress on priorities and targets. Establish reference accounts

  • Create a culture of high performance, with a focus on measurable talent development, inclusion, wellbeing, fun and representing UiPath values in every interaction with customers, partners and colleagues

  • Remain at the leading edge of a fast-paced innovation in AI/Automation to ensure UiPath provide thought leadership to impact our customers' mission-critical business challenges today and tomorrow

  • Ensure a psychologically safe environment for your team, based on the servant leadership principle

What you'll bring to the team

  • Extensive experience building, managing and coaching a high performing enterprise sales team and creating a winning culture

  • Ability to define and execute industry GTM strategy, with a demonstrable track record of executing GTM strategies in an enterprise software business

  • Experience leading differentiated sales models — for example, distinct strategic account, growth and new-business hunting motions — rather than a single generic sales role

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding sales targets

  • Domain credibility in Consumer, Retail, Travel & Hospitality, Media or Telecommunications, or a closely related enterprise vertical

  • Extensive experience working in a value driven sales environment

  • Experience providing executive sponsorship on strategic, complex, and competitive opportunities; immersed, customer facing, and in a solution-oriented capacity

  • Excellent analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to cross-functional audiences

  • The skill to build, manage, and nurture relationships at senior executive level, both internally and externally

  • Proven success in structuring and closing multi-million-dollar deals

  • Willingness to travel (40% to 60%) of time, as required for customer engagements

  • Experience of adopting rigorous sales methodologies ensuring accurate forecasting

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

jobs.title: IT Ops
jobs.description:
IT Ops

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

As Dust's first full time IT Ops hire in Paris, you'll own the infrastructure that keeps a fast-growing team running: from devices and access management to the systems and security practices that scale with us. This is a foundational role at a company where AI is woven into every workflow, giving you a front-row seat to how the future of work is actually being built. You'll work directly with the team and have real impact from day one.

What you'll do

Own Device & Endpoint Management

  • Provision, configure, and manage all employee hardware (Mac and Linux) across the Paris team

  • Maintain MDM tooling and ensure all devices meet security and compliance standards

  • Build and document onboarding/offboarding hardware workflows

Manage Identity & Access

  • Own IAM across SSO, Google Workspace, and third-party SaaS tools

  • Ensure access controls are current, auditable, and correctly scoped

  • Partner with the team to implement least-privilege access policies

Keep the Office Running

  • Manage AV, networking, and physical infrastructure at the Paris office

  • Be the first point of contact for IT issues — resolving quickly and building self-serve resources to reduce recurring requests

  • Coordinate with vendors and manage hardware inventory

Drive Security & Compliance

  • Support internal security reviews, audits, and compliance initiatives

  • Identify risks proactively and propose practical mitigations

  • Maintain IT documentation that stays accurate and useful

Build IT Systems That Scale

  • Automate repetitive processes and reduce manual IT overhead

  • Evaluate and implement new tools as the team grows

  • Contribute to IT roadmap planning alongside the Ops and Engineering teams

Requirements

Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions. Aptitude, Attitude and Agency.

Aptitude

  • Hands-on experience managing macOS and Linux endpoints in a SaaS or tech environment

  • Strong working knowledge of MDM solutions (Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent), SSO, and identity management platforms

  • Solid understanding of network fundamentals: routing, VPNs, DNS, and office connectivity

  • Comfortable working in security-conscious environments with an understanding of access control best practices

  • Able to document systems and processes clearly enough that others can operate them independently

Attitude

  • Shows up as a team multiplier — resolves issues without drama and leaves things better than they found them

  • Communicates proactively: flags problems early and follows through without needing to be chased

  • Takes user experience seriously — treats every colleague as a customer of IT

  • Gives and receives direct feedback without friction

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the priorities can shift

Agency

  • Proactively identifies IT risks and improvements before they become problems

  • Owns issues end-to-end: from diagnosis through resolution, without dropping the thread

  • Builds processes and automation that reduce recurring manual work for the team

  • Makes reasonable calls under ambiguity rather than escalating everything upward

  • Continuously looks for ways to use AI tools to improve how IT operations run at Dust

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: €79K – €100K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Brand Designer H/F
jobs.description:
Brand Designer H/F

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme la référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile).

Nous recherchons un.e Graphiste Confirmé(e) pour faire évoluer notre identité visuelle, la faire vivre sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et faire de notre site web une vitrine attractive. Tu intégreras l'équipe Communication et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, RH, Product, la Direction ainsi qu'avec nos prestataires externes.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Faire évoluer notre identité visuelle sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et en garantir la cohérence au quotidien.

  • Concevoir les créations de nos campagnes marketing : publicités, réseaux sociaux, emails, lancements produits et communications clients.

  • Rendre accessibles des sujets complexes (gestion des dépenses, finance, conformité, IA) grâce à des illustrations, infographies, schémas et vidéos.

  • Créer nos supports commerciaux et institutionnels : présentations, brochures, fiches produits, témoignages clients, documents corporate.

  • Produire les supports événementiels, de communication interne et de marque employeur : stands, signalétique, visuels, publications.

  • Construire une bibliothèque de modèles et de composants réutilisables pour faciliter le travail des équipes et garantir la qualité des productions.

  • Piloter le design et les évolutions courantes de notre site web (cohérence visuelle, parcours, landing pages, intégration de contenus), en lien avec l'agence qui gère la partie technique, et documenter composants et process.

  • Mener tes projets du brief à la livraison, dans le respect des délais et des contraintes de production digitale et print.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as environ 5 ans d'expérience en tant que graphiste dans un environnement B2B SaaS ou tech, en entreprise ou en agence auprès de clients B2B SaaS.

  • Tu maîtrises Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign et Figma, ainsi que les fondamentaux : typographie, composition, couleur, hiérarchie de l'information.

  • Tu as conçu des campagnes multicanales et tu connais les contraintes du digital comme du print.

  • Tu as une expérience pratique d'un CMS (création de pages, intégration de contenus, responsive) et une bonne compréhension des principes UX/UI, d'accessibilité et de conversion.

  • Tu utilises les outils de création assistée par l'IA avec pertinence, en gardant un regard exigeant sur la qualité, l'originalité et les droits d'utilisation.

  • Tu es créatif(ve), force de proposition, autonome et rigoureux(se), et tu as l'œil pour repérer la moindre erreur.

  • Tu sais mener plusieurs projets de front et défendre tes choix créatifs auprès des équipes.

  • Tu parles anglais couramment pour échanger avec nos équipes européennes.

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu as une expérience en fintech ou dans les services financiers.

  • Tu pratiques le motion design, notamment sur After Effects.

  • Tu sais faire du montage vidéo (réseaux sociaux, témoignages clients, lancements) : un format encore peu développé chez nous, que tu pourras faire grandir.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Une entreprise rentable, en pleine croissance, avec une dimension européenne.

  • Des projets variés qui laissent une large place à la créativité : on t'encourage à proposer, donner ton avis et challenger l'existant, en toute autonomie.

  • Un poste à fort impact : tes créations porteront l'évolution de notre identité et feront de notre site une vraie vitrine, génératrice de demandes de démo.

  • Une équipe soudée et bienveillante, où l'entraide fait partie du quotidien.

Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien téléphonique RH.

  • Entretien avec la VP of Communications

  • Mise en situation : étude de cas (présentation suivie d'un échange)

  • Rencontre avec l'équipe.

Télétravail hybride avec 2 jours de présence sur site à Montagnat (01250).

Rémunération : 35K€ - 40K€ fixe + variable

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul.

Rattaché.e au service développement éolien et sous la supervision de la Chargée d’Etudes Environnement, vous contribuerez à la bonne prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux tout au long des phases prospection, développement et construction des projets éolien terrestre.

  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se et force de propositions. Vous savez évoluer en autonomie dans vos recherches. Vous êtes doté.e d’un excellent relationnel.

Localisation : Lyon - déplacements ponctuels en Bourgogne-Franche-Comté, Auvergne-Rhône Alpes (frais pris en charge)

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ?

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Index Intelligence

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.

We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

  • You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

  • Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

  • You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

  • You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Content Understanding

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience

  • Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

  • You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

  • You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

  • You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

  • You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

  • Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

  • Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

  • Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

  • Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

  • Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

jobs.title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
jobs.description:
Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines.

Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht.

Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten;

  • Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties;

  • Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen;

  • Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties;

  • Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd;

  • Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service.

Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen.


Wij vragen

  • HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar.

Wij bieden

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

You'll bring structure where it's missing, challenge assumptions that slow things down, and take ownership of projects that currently sit with leadership. You're the kind of person who spots a blocker on Monday and has it resolved by Tuesday.

Tech hiring is what will make or break our growth, and you'll be the person who builds the foundation that makes it possible. Real ownership, real visibility, and a direct line to shaping Mollie's future.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Analytics Engineer

About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team

You will join Alma’s central Data team, which supports a wide range of business teams, including Finance, Product, Marketing, Risk, and Operations. The team is made up of six Data Analysts, including several experienced colleagues, and works at the intersection of Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and business teams.

Reporting to Gil Marlard, you will help strengthen the data foundations that support reporting, analytics, operational processes, and business decision-making.

This position is a permanent (CDI) role based in Paris, with a hybrid working model, we are also open to full remote in France.

About the job

As an Analytics Engineer, you will help strengthen the data foundations that support the whole organization. The central Data team serves a wide range of business teams, including Finance, Product, Marketing, Risk, and Operations. You will join a team of six Data Analysts, including several experienced colleagues, and work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Data Analytics, and business teams.

You will transform raw data into trusted datasets that support reporting, analytics, operational processes, such as deciding which customer to call, and business decision-making.

Our data foundations currently have different levels of maturity across business teams, and part of our ambition is to rebuild and standardize some of them. Your work will be particularly important in enabling more self-service and conversational analytics for our business teams, by making data easier to find, understand, trust, and use.

A key part of your role will be improving the lineage and governance of our tables, following a medallion-inspired approach with clear layers.

Data modeling and data quality

  • Build and maintain reusable data models, macros, and semantic layers in dbt and BigQuery

  • Develop staging, intermediate, and mart models following clear data modeling principles

  • Implement data quality tests, freshness checks, and documentation

  • Improve the lineage, ownership, and discoverability of our most important tables

  • Strengthen our semantic layer and ensure that metric definitions are consistent

  • Identify and remove duplicated, obsolete, or deprecated datasets and content

  • Optimize queries and models for reliability, performance, and cost

Central Data Analytics Community

  • Build reusable data assets that can be leveraged by Data Analysts across different business domains

  • Lead enablement by mentoring analysts and training them on dbt, Looker, governance, and metric definitions

  • Partner on the data platform roadmap across GCP, BigQuery, Argo, dbt, and Looker

  • Contribute to keeping our data stack clean, reliable, and easy to maintain

  • Participate in code reviews and help define analytics engineering standards

  • Discuss and validate data contracts with the rest of the Engineering team

  • Collaborate with Data Analysts, Data Engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted and actionable data

You will work with

dbt, BigQuery, Looker, GCP, Argo, Git, Claude

About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have at least 2 years of experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, or a similar role.

  • You have practical experience with dbt, including models, tests, and documentation.

  • You have a good understanding of data modeling concepts such as facts, dimensions, keys, and relationships.

  • You have experience with Git and pull-request-based development, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with technical and business teams. You are fluent in English.

And it will be nice if you also

  • You are familiar with BigQuery, Looker, GCP, and Airflow or Argo.

  • You have knowledge of Python.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

What's in it for you

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

  • The opportunity to shape analytics engineering practices within a growing and experienced central Data team

  • Exposure to modern data tools including dbt, Argo, Claude, GCP

  • A collaborative environment focused on improving data reliability, data literacy, and self-service analytics

Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months

  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package

  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma

  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)

  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma

  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform

  • Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)

  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform

  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

Interview Process

  • Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation & present you the role.

  • Video call with your future manager to deep dive the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.

  • Case study presentation with 2 - 3 team members (ideally in house) to assess your practical knowledge.

  • 1 or 2 additional interviews customized to the role's level to further assess your skills and team fit.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Senior Software/AI Engineer

EggAI · Full-time · Remote (EU & UK)

The Role

A very strong senior software engineer with deep, hands-on experience building and operating production systems. We hire for engineering strength first: people who write good software, reason about failure, and own what they ship.

You will work in a team of 2 to 6 engineers on a client project. Clients come to us because we work at the forefront of AI in the enterprise; you help implement our AI strategy.

AI experience is required. Much of our work involves LLM-powered and agentic systems, and while you may not be working directly on LLMs, you will be working on LLM based systems.

What You'll Do

  • Build and operate the production systems at the centre of the engagement, end to end — you own what you ship, including after it's reached production

  • Lead architecture discussions for your part of the system, with the support of the wider team

  • Take ownership: pick up the ambiguous problem, chase down the answer, and say so when something is going wrong

  • Work directly with the client's engineers and with our project manager / product owner

  • Work in a "normal" team rhythm — daily standups, planning, retrospectives, code and design review

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years designing, building and maintaining production systems that real users depend on — clean testable code, sound API and data modelling, and the judgement to know which abstractions are worth it

  • Production AI experience: You have built and operated GenAI systens in production with real users

  • Has owned code in production — deployment, monitoring, on-call or equivalent — and can debug hard problems in live systems: concurrency, performance, data correctness

  • Distributed systems fundamentals: services, queues, retries, idempotency, failure modes, and integrating third-party APIs that are not reliable

  • Databases: schema design, query performance, migrations

  • Operational rigour: meaningful automated testing, useful instrumentation, CI/CD and shipping incrementally

  • Client-facing ability: has delivered against real business requirements and can hold a technical conversation with non-engineers

  • Languages: Python (primary), TypeScript/JavaScript. Strong engineers coming from Go, Java, C#, Rust or similar who are willing to work in Python are in scope

  • Infrastructure: cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerisation

Desired qualities

  • Depth — you can explain the systems you built and the trade-offs you chose

  • Balances speed of iteration with production reliability

  • Clear communicator, in writing as well as in conversation

  • Learns new domains quickly and deliberately

Interview Process

  1. Introductory call - 30 minutes

  2. Behavioural/Management interview - 60 minutes

  3. Technical interview (choice of walking through own code, live coding, or take home exercise) - 60 minutes

jobs.title: Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Cloud Security Engineer

A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.

You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.

We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.

We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

  • You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

  • You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

  • You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

  • You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

  • You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

  • You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • Bonus: Go or Postgres security, policy-as-code, supply chain security, or securing AI/LLM-powered products.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £110K – £200K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
Operations Lead

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, EMEA
jobs.description:
Solutions Architect, EMEA

About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Solutions Architects are the technical tip of the spear in Exa's presales motion. From the first call to the technical win, you're the person who shows prospects what Exa can do and proves it works for their use case. You partner with Account Executives on new accounts and new opportunities, and you're measured on technical wins, POC conversion, and pipeline velocity. You'll cover accounts across EMEA from our London office.

You'll run discovery with engineers and executives, build demos that land, design and run workshops and proofs of concept, and make the technical case for Exa against alternatives. When a deal needs specialist depth, you pull in our Forward Deployed Engineers. When a deal closes, you hand the customer off to them with everything they need to get to production fast. This is not a demo-only role. You are an engineer who sells.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the technical side of new opportunities alongside Account Executives, from first call through technical win

  • Run discovery to understand a prospect's use case, architecture, data needs, and success criteria, and qualify where Exa fits

  • Build and deliver tailored demos, sample apps, and prototypes that show what Exa can do on the prospect's own problem

  • Design and run workshops and POCs with clear success criteria, timelines, and evaluation plans, then drive them to a decision

  • Win technical evaluations by benchmarking Exa on quality, latency, and cost, and making a clear case against alternatives

  • Handle technical objections and answer security, compliance, and architecture questions

  • Bring in Forward Deployed Engineers as specialists when a deal needs deeper expertise, and run a clean handoff to them after close

  • Feed market signal back to Product: what prospects ask for, where we lose, and what would help us win

  • Build reusable pre-sales assets such as demo environments, reference architectures, and evaluation playbooks

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on programming experience. You can build compelling demos, implement POCs end to end, and design and run rigorous evals in head-to-head competitive scenarios

  • 2+ years of hands-on presales or technical sales experience, ideally at an AI-native or developer-first company. You've owned the technical side of deals, run discovery and demos with technical buyers, and helped carry opportunities to close

  • Strong communication skills: you can adapt your pitch to CTOs, engineers, and PMs alike, and explain complex technology simply

  • Track record of high performance in demanding environments, whether that's a top CS program, a competitive sport, a startup, or something else entirely

  • High tolerance for context-switching, ambiguity, and sustained intensity

  • Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and workshops

You might excel if you...

  • Have worked as a solutions architect, solutions engineer, or sales engineer at a developer-tools, API, or AI company

  • Have built with LLMs, RAG, or agents and can talk credibly about retrieval and search quality

  • Have helped close revenue or driven commercial outcomes at a previous company

  • Thrive in early-stage environments where your job description changes monthly

  • Love the moment a prospect sees a demo and gets it

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is an in-person opportunity in London.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Forward Deployed Engineer

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

jobs.description:
People Tech & Analytics Engineer

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a People Tech & Analytics Engineer on the People team, you will build the systems, data pipelines, and automations behind how Mistral runs People Operations. Reporting to the People Tech & Analytics Lead, you will turn the roadmap into reality: wiring our HR tech stack together, making data flow reliably between systems, and automating people processes with third-party tools as well as Mistral's own models, agents, and APIs.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who loves building. You will spend most of your time in the systems and the data, deep-diving into problems: connecting HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity, and finance tools, standing up the data layer behind our people metrics, and shipping automations that remove manual work from the People team.

If you are a data engineer or people technology specialist who wants to deliver meaningful automation outcomes at Europe's largest AI company, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations and data pipelines across our HR systems (HRIS, ATS, payroll, identity and finance), run data quality checks, and fix inconsistencies at the source.

  • Implement and evolve the Metabase visualisation layer of our people data lake, build the dashboards and self-serve reporting managers and People partners rely on, and run hands-on analyses of workforce trends, retention and organisational health, supporting the move to conversational insights for leadership.

  • Design, build, test and document automated workflows, mainly with Mistral's own models, agents and APIs, with human review wherever decisions affect people, monitor live automations with alerting, error handling, logging and runbooks, and prototype AI use cases on people processes, productionising the ones that prove their worth.

  • Implement configuration changes across the HR tech stack (workflows, fields, roles and permissions, new countries and entities), support testing and rollout of system changes and integrations, and act as first-line troubleshooter for the People team, leading issue resolution through to production with a clear audit trail.

  • Architect end-to-end HR workflows with key stakeholders in HR Operations, Business Partnering and Reward, and implement data governance in practice: quality standards, access controls, retention rules and audit trails for employee data.

  • Provide clear enablement materials in Notion so the People team and managers can use our systems confidently, with strong tier-1 support via a bot.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or HR technology, ideally within an HR or People function or working closely with one as a stakeholder.

  • Strong practical SQL and Python skills: you are comfortable building pipelines and transformations yourself.

  • Hands-on experience with HR systems such as Ashby, and integrating them with ATS, payroll, identity and finance tools via APIs, middleware and data pipelines.

  • Real automation experience: you have built and maintained workflows in n8n or similar tools such as Make, Zapier, Workato or Langdock, and you are excited to do the same with Mistral's own models and tooling.

  • Working experience with data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery) and the modern data stack (dbt or similar), and with visualisation tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau or Power BI.

  • You are low-ego and team-spirited, and you take a prioritised problem and run with it in ambiguity: you would rather build a first version and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. You start from the HR need, not the technology, stay hands-on, and have a track record of building foundations in growing organisations without creating legacy.

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 22 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition: Product Design at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

At Polarsteps, everyone, our CEO, support specialists, developers, product managers, and more, cares about design. It’s part of our DNA and embedded in every discussion. This gives you, as a Product Designer, the opportunity to make full use of your skills and craft your designs to perfection.

Our relatively small team consists of like-minded design enthusiasts who can geek out over the nitty-gritty details–corner radius, shadows, colors–for hours. We are big on collaboration, challenge each other, and make meetings as fun as they are productive. We dream big, move fast and welcome ideas, from anyone.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.

Lead the design of our “Digital Relive” team, focused on one of travel’s most meaningful moments: looking back on it all. We’re building new ways for travelers to relive their trips, both on the road and once they’re home, from in-app experiences to shareable formats like Trip Reels and Map Video.

You will:

  • Oversee the full product lifecycle of concepting, prototyping, and iterating based on design reviews, user testing, feedback, and data like share rates.

  • Implement and maintain the existing design & brand guidelines while also creating and adapting guidelines to elevate the overall Polarsteps design, including the look and feel of our shareable formats.

  • Own your product pillar, while maintaining close collaboration with the other pillars. Proactively ask for and share feedback to keep our product smooth, consistent, and awesome.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to ensure your designs are well-specced and built as intended, down to the last pixel and color.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

✅ Being a seasoned professional with 5+ years of experience designing lovable products;
✅ A strong portfolio, with shipped designs, that demonstrates end-to-end (hybrid UX and UI) product design, with a strong visual eye for typography, layout, and storytelling;
✅ Experience designing for native mobile apps;
✅ Hands-on experience with user insights and testing, like A/B tests and usability studies;
✅ A proactive mindset, with a passion for getting involved in the entire product development process, thinking and problem-solving like a product manager;
✅ Fluency in modern design tools such as Figma/Sketch or similar;
✅ Experience in prototyping tools such as Principle/Protopie or similar;
✅ Skills in partnering with engineers to drive QA processes and uphold implementation fidelity;
✅ A genuine interest in motion, video, and visual storytelling, and the curiosity to grow in it. You don’t need to be an After Effects pro, but you get excited about how things move and feel.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Hands-on experience with motion or video tools (like After Effects or Premiere), or with designing for social platforms like Instagram and TikTok. Not a dealbreaker if that’s not your world yet; it’s something we’re happy to grow together.

 

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 75.000 - 90.000 gross per year incl 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, assessed during the interview process.
