Android Developer – Connected Fitness Devices & Apps (m/f/d)

Build Android software that gets people moving

Want to develop Android apps and see your code become part of a real product? At AUGLETICS, you will work on software for our connected rowing machines and our app. You can try out new features on the equipment and improve them with the team, from an early prototype to a reliable experience for our customers.

We develop and manufacture in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin. Our company has around 25 people. You will join a software team of four to five and work directly with our CTO, Christopher Klabunde. We have plenty of ideas and are looking for someone who enjoys building things, thinks for themselves and cares about quality.

What you will work on

  • Android development: Build new features for our device software and app, improve existing workflows and create an intuitive, reliable user experience.

  • Connected systems: Work on interfaces between the app, device software and backend, helping make data flows and error handling reliable.

  • Hands-on prototyping: Turn ideas into working prototypes, try them on our rowing machines and develop promising approaches with the team.

  • Quality from the start: Write understandable, maintainable code, take part in reviews and tests, and fix problems thoroughly.

  • AI-assisted development: Use AI tools for ideas, coding, testing and debugging. Understand and verify their output before it becomes part of the product.

What you bring

  • Programming fundamentals and an interest in native Android development with Kotlin or Java. Android experience is welcome; if you are new to it, tell us how you learn and why it interests you.

  • The ability to explain how you approach a technical problem. Personal apps, learning projects, university work, internships and student jobs all count alongside professional experience.

  • An interest in writing reliable, maintainable software and learning how to test it well.

  • Openness to AI-assisted app development and a willingness to question and check the results.

  • Initiative, a collaborative approach and the desire to learn an existing product and gradually take ownership.

  • Good spoken and written English is required. You need to discuss technical topics confidently with the team. German is not required, but it is a strong advantage.

  • The ability to work regularly on site in Königs Wusterhausen, where we develop and test directly on the devices.

A degree in computer science or a related subject, relevant vocational training, or equivalent knowledge provides a good foundation.

Experienced or just starting out? We would like to meet you

Already have several years of experience? Great – bring your ideas and a fresh perspective. New to this field or looking for your first professional role? That is welcome too. If you are excited about our product, have a technical foundation and learn quickly, we would like to hear from you.

Whichever stage you are at, it is our job to help you settle into the team and provide the knowledge, tools and support you need to succeed. You will get to know our product and ways of working alongside Chris and the team. We will match your initial tasks and responsibilities to your experience and help you grow from there.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Firebase as an app backend, for example user authentication, data storage or server-side logic.

  • Experience in iOS development, ideally with Swift or SwiftUI.

  • Knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, API integration or connecting software to devices.

What we offer

  • A real product you can try out yourself, with a direct impact on how our customers train.

  • A company of around 25 people, a small software team and close collaboration with CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Room for your ideas and professional growth, with responsibilities that develop with your skills.

  • A permanent, full-time position: 40 hours per week and 28 days of annual leave.

  • €50,000–€65,000 gross per year, depending on your relevant skills and experience.

  • A workplace in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one or two days of working from home per week by agreement.

Working near Berlin

Our office is at Zur Heide 10, Königs Wusterhausen. The town has direct S46 S-Bahn and regional train connections to Berlin; you can cycle from the station to our office. Regular on-site work matters because development, testing and teamwork happen around the actual rowing machines. This is a hybrid role based in Germany.

How to apply

Send us your CV in English or German. No formal cover letter is needed. A GitHub link or an app you have worked on is welcome, but optional.

Four optional questions

Answer any of these if you would like to. A few bullet points in English or German are enough. No extra document or application assignment is required.

  1. What interests you about developing software for a connected fitness product? What would you like to learn or help us improve?

  2. What have you programmed or taught yourself so far? If you have worked with Android, Firebase or iOS, what was your own contribution? Feel free to share a link.

  3. Which AI tools have you tried for development or learning, and how do you check their output? If you have not used them yet, what would you like to explore?

  4. How comfortable are you discussing technical topics in English? Does regular on-site work in Königs Wusterhausen suit you, and when could you start?

We will start with a short online conversation, followed by a closer look at your experience, learning approach and the work at AUGLETICS.

jobs.title: Accountant (all genders)
jobs.description:
Accountant (all genders)

JOIN US

Bei Code Gaia zu arbeiten bedeutet, dass du an etwas sehr Wichtigem arbeitest: Der Transformation zu einer nachhaltigen Wirtschaft. Wir sind dafür da, dass Nachhaltigkeit nicht mühsam oder zeitaufwendig für Unternehmen ist. Stattdessen wollen wir kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen ermutigen, gemeinsam gegen den Klimawandel und soziale Ungerechtigkeit vorzugehen.

Als Internal Accountant bist du das Rückgrat unserer täglichen Finanzprozesse: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung, sorgst für saubere und pünktliche Zahlungsläufe und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere externe Steuerberatung. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Finance Controller, unserem Revenue-Operations-Team und unserem Head of Finance zusammen und trägst so maßgeblich dazu bei, dass unser wachsendes Team auf einer soliden finanziellen Grundlage aufbauen kann.

WHAT YOU DO

  • Du verantwortest die laufende Finanzbuchhaltung (Kreditoren- und Debitorenbuchhaltung) und sorgst für eine saubere, revisionssichere Ablage aller Belege
  • Du prüfst Eingangsrechnungen, bereitest Zahlungsläufe vor und gibst sie über unser Tool Moss frei, damit bei uns finanziell nichts liegen bleibt
  • Du unterstützt bei Ausgangsrechnungen und offenen Forderungen über unsere Systeme (Younium, Easybill, HubSpot) und stimmst dich dazu mit Revenue Operations ab
  • Du übernimmst die Kreditkartenverwaltung und -abrechnung für das gesamte Team
  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und arbeitest eng mit unserem Steuerberater zusammen
  • Du unterstützt bei der Pflege unseres Cash Calendars und lieferst dem Finance Controller verlässliche Zahlen für Liquiditätsplanung und Forecasts
  • Du erstellst Ad-hoc-Auswertungen und spezifische Reportings für den Head of Finance, Finance Controller und weitere Stakeholder
  • Wir unterstützen dich beim Einsatz von KI-Tools (z. B. Claude), mit denen du wiederkehrende Buchhaltungsprozesse automatisieren kannst.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Du bringst praktisch Erufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung oder Finance Operations mit, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld
  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Steuerfachangestellte:r, Bilanzbuchhalter:in) oder ein vergleichbares Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Accounting
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der doppelten Buchführung sowie idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit SaaS-spezifischen Themen wie wiederkehrenden Umsätzen (ARR) oder Subscription Billing
  • Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und behältst auch bei hohem Belegvolumen und wiederkehrenden Aufgaben den Überblick
  • Du kommunizierst klar, freundlich und lösungsorientiert – auch im Kontakt mit externer Steuerberatung und Kund:innen
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit gängigen Buchhaltungs- und Rechnungsstellungs-Tools (z. B. Moss, DATEV, Younium, Easybill, HubSpot o. ä.)
  • Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich und übernimmst Ownership für deinen Bereich
  • Du besitzt Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau
  • Du hast gute Englischkenntnisse, da unsere interne Arbeitssprache Englisch ist

WHAT TO EXPECT

Hybrid Work & Freedom | Wir glauben fest daran, dass jedes Arbeitsumfeld ideal und auf die jeweilige Person zugeschnitten sein muss. Aus diesem Grund arbeiten unsere Teammitglieder remote oder in unseren Büros in München oder Berlin - auf ihre eigene Art und Weise. So können wir sicherstellen, dass alle unsere Talente viel Freiraum haben, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Ownership & Impact | Bei Code Gaia haben alle unsere Teammitglieder eine Stimme. Wir schätzen jede Meinung und ermutigen alle, ihre Meinung zu sagen. Nur mit Teamarbeit können wir etwas Sinnvolles schaffen. Wir glauben an unser Team und geben ihm daher viel Eigenverantwortung. Selbst wenn wir scheitern, lernen wir daraus, stehen wieder auf und arbeiten weiter am Erfolg. Das ist Teil des Spiels und wir wissen es.

Personal & Professional Growth | Deine Entwicklung ist unsere Priorität. Mit unserem intensiven Onboarding, Feedbackgesprächen und Schulungen fördern wir deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung. Einer unserer Kernwerte ist "Keep Growing" (Wachsen), den wir in allem, was wir tun, zum Ausdruck bringen.

Best Equipment, Tech Stack & Processes | Du arbeitest mit bewährten Prozessen, bist aber jederzeit eingeladen, diese zu hinterfragen. Außerdem möchten wir, dass du so produktiv wie möglich bist - sag uns, was du brauchen, um produktiv zu sein.

C ompetitive salary package | Wir bieten ein faires Gehalt. Code Gaia ist auf dem besten Weg, in die Höhe zu schießen, und wir möchten, dass du ein Teil davon bist und an unserer Wachstumsreise teilnimmst.

Team Events | Wir wissen, dass es schwierig sein kann, einen starken Teamgeist aufzubauen, wenn man ausschließlich aus der Ferne arbeitet. Bei Code Gaia legen wir jedoch großen Wert auf die Teambildung und veranstalten das ganze Jahr über verschiedene Teamevents. Schau dir z.B. den letzten LigaConvent unserer Unternehmensgruppe an. Wir verstehen die Notwendigkeit der Interaktion von Angesicht zu Angesicht und ermutigen sie stark.

Impact driven & passionate team | Zu guter Letzt sind wir das wirkungsorientierteste Team, das du dir vorstellen kannst. Wir lieben die Zusammenarbeit und leben unsere Unternehmenswerte jeden Tag. Darüberhinaus kompensiert Code Gaia natürlich den eigenen CO2-Fußabdruck.

Is it a Match?

Dann schicke uns gerne deine Unterlagen zu. Wir freuen uns, dich zeitnah kennenzulernen!

Bei Code Gaia wirst Du Teil eines multikulturellen und interdisziplinären Teams. Wir sind bestrebt, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder Mitarbeitende seinen Beitrag bestmöglich einbringen kann. jobs.title: Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)

Bei Knuspr zählt Geschwindigkeit. Qualität zählt. Aber nichts davon funktioniert ohne Menschen, die vom ersten Tag an genau wissen, was sie tun.

Genau hier kommen unsere Trainer ins Spiel.

Wir suchen einen Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d), der neuen Kolleg:innen hilft, sich schnell einzuarbeiten, die Abläufe richtig zu lernen und sich zu selbstbewussten, leistungsstarken Teammitgliedern zu entwickeln. Diese Rolle verbindet Onboarding, Coaching und Kulturarbeit – und ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dafür, wie gut unsere Teams im Lager funktionieren.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, durch Vorleben erklärst und andere jeden Tag besser machen willst, könnte das gut zu dir passen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell neue Mitarbeitende produktiv und sicher arbeiten

  • Du prägst die Teamkultur auf der Lagerfläche – nicht vom Schreibtisch aus

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften zusammen und bist wichtiger Partner für Performance, Onboarding und Entwicklung

  • Du unterstützt sowohl neue als auch bestehende Mitarbeitende – kein Tag ist wie der andere

  • Du bist die Person, auf die andere sich verlassen: für Orientierung, Klarheit und Unterstützung

Deine Aufgaben

Du unterstützt Mitarbeitende im Lager dabei, sich weiterzuentwickeln und erfolgreich zu sein.

Du wirst:

  • Das Onboarding neuer Lager-Mitarbeitender koordinieren

  • Mitarbeitende in verschiedenen Lagerbereichen und Prozessen schulen

  • Trainingsmaterialien und Methoden mitentwickeln und verbessern

  • Regelmäßig Feedback geben, motivieren und Leistung fördern

  • Unterstützungsbedarfe erkennen und praxisnahe Entwicklungspläne erstellen

  • Die Einhaltung von Lagerprozessen und -regeln überprüfen

  • Eng mit Führungskräften bei Trainings- und Entwicklungsmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten

  • Neue Prozesse im Lager begleiten und Teams dabei unterstützen, diese zu verstehen

  • Trainingserfolge evaluieren und Verbesserungen ableiten

  • Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Fragen und Unterstützung auf der Fläche agieren

  • Als Vorbild für Knuspr-Kultur, Teamarbeit und Kundenorientierung auftreten

Was wir suchen

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Training (Lager- oder Operations-Erfahrung von Vorteil)

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Offenheit für ein dynamisches, schnelles Umfeld

  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Freude an der Arbeit mit Menschen

  • Ruhe und Fairness auch unter Druck

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Fokus auf Weiterentwicklung anderer

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Apps, Tools und neuen Technologien

  • Selbstständige, proaktive Arbeitsweise

  • Stark ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, auch im operativen Alltag

Sprachkenntnisse: Du benötigst sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

  • Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf den Unternehmenserfolg

  • Gute Ideen werden schnell umgesetzt – ohne lange Konzernprozesse

  • Keine starren Corporate-Strukturen

  • Die Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich zu verändern und nicht nur Trends zu folgen

  • Faire Vergütung sowie Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Weiterbildung

  • Teil eines engagierten Teams und Teilnahme an besonderen Company-Events

#LI-AR1 #Knuspr

jobs.title: Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warehouse Trainer (m/w/d)

At Knuspr, speed matters. Quality matters. But none of it works without people who know what they’re doing from day one.

That’s where our trainers come in.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Trainer who will help new colleagues settle in fast, learn the job properly, and grow into confident, high-performing team members. This role is part onboarding, part coaching, part culture-building — and a big part of what makes our warehouse teams work well together.

If you enjoy working with people, teaching by example, and helping others improve every day, this could be a great fit.

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll have a direct impact on how quickly new employees become productive and confident.

  • You’ll help shape team culture on the warehouse floor — not from behind a desk.

  • You’ll work closely with managers and become a key partner in performance, onboarding and development.

  • You’ll support both newcomers and existing employees, so no two days look the same.

  • You’ll be in a role where people genuinely rely on you — for guidance, clarity and support

What you’ll do

You’ll be responsible for helping warehouse employees learn, improve and succeed in daily operations.

You will:

  • Coordinate onboarding for new warehouse employees

  • Train employees across different warehouse departments and processes

  • Support the creation and improvement of training materials and methods

  • Give regular feedback, motivate people and help them improve performance

  • Identify where individuals need more support and create practical improvement plans

  • Check whether warehouse rules and processes are followed correctly

  • Work closely with managers on training progress and employee development

  • Help introduce new warehouse processes and make sure teams understand them

  • Evaluate training effectiveness and suggest improvements based on real needs

  • Be the go-to person for everyday questions, support and guidance on the floor

  • Act as a role model for Rohlik culture, teamwork and customer orientation

What we’re looking for

  • At least 1 year of training experience; warehouse or operations background is a plus

  • Open-minded, hands-on and comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communicator with a natural feel for working with people

  • Calm under pressure and able to make quick, fair decisions

  • Structured, attentive and focused on helping others improve

  • Comfortable using apps, tools and new technologies

  • Self-starter who can work independently and get things done

  • Strong customer-oriented mindset, even in an operational role

Language requirements: You need professional working proficiency in English or German. Additional foreign languages are a strong advantage.

What we offer

  • Your work will have a direct impact on the company's results

  • We will implement your good ideas almost immediately – not waiting for the approval of the headquarters somewhere in the world

  • You will not be bound by corporate processes

  • Your work has to be innovative and meaningful, we do not want to follow trends, but set them

  • Last but not least, we offer a fair reward for your work and the possibility for professional growth and further education. We also offer you to be part of a great bunch of people and to attend a legendary corporate event.

#LI-AR1 #Knuspr

jobs.title: Career Coach (all genders)
jobs.description:
Career Coach (all genders)

Jobbeschreibung

Als Career Coach begleitest Du unsere Lernenden auf dem entscheidendsten Abschnitt ihres Weges: dem Sprung in den neuen Job. Mit gezieltem Bewerbungscoaching, individueller Karriereberatung und einer klaren Portion Motivation machst Du aus Unsicherheit, Selbstvertrauen und Qualifikationen echte Jobangebote.

Unsere Kurse vermitteln unseren Teilnehmenden echte, marktfähige Kompetenzen. Du sorgst dafür, dass diese auch von der Außenwelt gesehen werden, indem Du ihnen hilfst, ihre neuen Fähigkeiten sichtbar zu machen, selbstbewusst zu kommunizieren und in überzeugende Bewerbungen zu verwandeln.

Dabei bist Du nicht allein: Der Coaching-Prozess ist strukturiert, die Qualität abgesichert, und Du arbeitest eng mit dem Career Coaching Lead zusammen. Dein Fokus: Teilnehmende begleiten, dass sie ihren Berufseinstieg mit Klarheit und Zuversicht angehen.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle

  • Leitung eigener Kurse und Workshops zu Bewerbungsstrategien, Interview Training, Motivation und beruflicher Neuorientierung

  • 1:1-Coaching zur Unterstützung bei Jobsuche, Interviewvorbereitung und der Erstellung persönlicher Kompetenzprofile

  • Unterstützung bei professionellen Bewerbungsunterlagen und der Entwicklung einer klaren beruflichen Positionierung

  • Förderung von Motivation und Teilnehmenden Bindung durch eine vertrauensvolle, positive Coaching-Atmosphäre

  • Auf- und Ausbau eines aktiven Firmen- und Alumni-Netzwerks zur Förderung von Austausch, Kooperation und erfolgreicher Vermittlung

  • Analyse und Weiterentwicklung interner Career-Success-Prozesse sowie Unterstützung des Client Operations & Career Coaching Lead bei strategischen Projekten

  • Dokumentation und Reporting von Vermittlungsquoten, Coaching-Aktivitäten und Feedback an den Career Coaching Lead

Das bringst Du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation in Pädagogik, Psychologie oder Coaching

  • Erfahrung in Karriereberatung, Bewerbungscoaching oder Lernbegleitung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools (z. B. MS Office, CRM-Systeme, Projektmanagement-Tools) sowie Routine in der Erstellung von Präsentationen für Trainings, Management und Kooperationspartner

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du passt Deine Ansprache an individuelle Bedürfnisse an und moderierst Gruppen sicher

  • Eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, auch bei der parallelen Steuerung mehrerer Career Coaching-Prozesse

  • Einfühlungsvermögen, Empathie und aktives Zuhören

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1)


Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

jobs.description:
Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w|m|d) interne Qualitätssicherung Wirtschaftsprüfung – Vollzeit oder Teilzeit

Der Verband Sächsischer Wohnungsgenossenschaften e. V. (VSWG) ist gesetzlicher Prüfungsverband sowie Fach- und Interessenverband der sächsischen Wohnungsgenossenschaften. In den Bereichen Prüfung, Beratung, Weiterbildung und Interessenvertretung begleitet der VSWG seine Mitgliedsgenossenschaften.

Mit Genauigkeit für geprüfte Qualität

Als Mitarbeiter / Leiter (w/m/d) übernehmen Sie eine wichtige Rolle in der internen auftragsbezogenen Qualitätssicherung der Wirtschaftsprüfung. Genauigkeit, Struktur und fachliche Tiefe prägen dabei Ihren Arbeitsalltag. Ihre Tätigkeit umfasst insbesondere die formelle und materielle Berichtskritik:

  • Sie prüfen Prüfungsberichte auf Zahlenkonsistenz, inhaltliche Plausibilität und sprachliche Korrektheit und berücksichtigen dabei interne Qualitätsstandards und Fristen.

  • Sie stellen die formelle und fachliche Richtigkeit sowie die Vollständigkeit der Berichte sicher.

  • Tabellen und Texte kontrollieren Sie auf rechnerische und orthografische Korrektheit.

  • Hinweise auf mögliche Bilanzierungsfehler identifizieren Sie und geben diese entsprechend weiter.

  • Sie pflegen Berichtsdateien, bereiten diese vor und übernehmen die finale Aufbereitung.

Zudem wirken Sie an der Fortentwicklung, Durchsetzung und Überwachung des gemäß § 55b WPO bestehenden internen Qualitätssicherungssystems mit.


Fachliches Know-how trifft auf sorgfältiges Arbeiten

Für die Berichtsprüfung und Berichtskritik bringen Sie ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und Zusammenhänge mit. Eine strukturierte und präzise Arbeitsweise bildet die Grundlage für Ihre Tätigkeit.

Rahmenbedingungen für Ihre berufliche Entwicklung

jobs.description:
Mid Market Sales Manager (Paris)

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence across French Mid-Market and SMB customers. This is an opportunity to shape how we reach and grow a broad range of businesses, from developing an efficient sales motion to helping customers see value quickly and expand over time.

You’ll act as the business lead for the segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable approach that balances efficient execution with the different needs of SMB and Mid-Market customers.

You’ll also coordinate the teams that support pipeline generation, sales, and customer growth. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll focus resources on the channels and activities that can best support the segment’s goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the sales team for the Mid-Market and SMB segment, including hiring, performance, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Define and refine the sales approach for SMB and Mid-Market customers, adapting qualification, messaging, and deal support to each customer’s needs.

  • Build an efficient path from target account and first conversation through qualification, evaluation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on discovery, value-based selling, pipeline discipline, and helping customers make decisions with confidence.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on customer conversations, deal patterns, and segment needs.

  • Work with BDR and Growth leaders to build qualified pipeline through targeted outbound and other relevant channels.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize campaigns, events, customer advocacy, and community programs that support pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support segment priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on relevant sourcing, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support effective evaluations, smooth implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share market learning with the CRO and other segment leads, helping Dust develop a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience selling to SMB and Mid-Market customers, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion to different deal sizes, buying processes, and customer needs.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end and building pipeline through functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience coaching sellers, building a reliable forecast, and creating consistent sales practices.

  • Good commercial judgment about where to focus team capacity and budget, including how direct sales, marketing, and partners can support growth.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building repeatable sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Mid-Market and SMB segment has clear sales ownership, a focused pipeline, and progress against its ARR goals. Sellers are well coached and can execute an efficient, repeatable motion suited to their customers. Cross-functional support is aligned to segment priorities, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust improve how it serves and grows SMB and Mid-Market accounts in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Ingénieur Intégration Logicielle H/F

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Intégration Logicielle avec expérience en systèmes d'imagerie médicale, intégration PACS et validation de workflow de bout en bout. Le poste consiste à vérifier et valider les solutions logicielles déployées en milieu clinique, en assurant une interopérabilité fluide avec PACS, modalités d'imagerie, écosystèmes de distributeurs et infrastructures IT santé.

Le candidat retenu planifiera et réalisera des activités d'intégration et de validation, évaluera le comportement du système sur les chaînes de traitement complètes, et garantira la fiabilité des workflows cliniques en conditions réelles.

Responsabilités

  • Vérifier l'interopérabilité entre la solution logicielle et les systèmes de santé externes

  • Valider les workflows d'imagerie de bout en bout, de l'acquisition à la revue et au reporting.

  • Effectuer des tests d'intégration, système, workflow, régression et acceptation utilisateur dans des environnements clients représentatifs.

  • Évaluer la performance et le comportement du produit selon les configurations et cas d'usage cliniques.

  • Planifier, concevoir et exécuter les activités d'intégration et validation du logiciel d'imagerie médicale selon IEC 62304 et exigences réglementaires.

  • Contribuer aux vérifications et validations fondées sur les risques, conformément à ISO 14971.

  • Assurer la traçabilité entre exigences, risques, preuves de test et rapports de validation.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes développement, réglementaire, clinique, produit et distributeurs pour résoudre les problèmes et améliorer la qualité.

  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des méthodologies de validation, environnements et ressources de tests.

Tâches clés

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre les plans et rapports d'intégration et validation

  • Réaliser des validations manuelles et automatisées des workflows opérationnels avec diverses applications tierces.

  • Valider l'interopérabilité DICOM, l'échange, le stockage, le routage et la récupération d'images.

  • Vérifier les procédures d'installation, configuration, mise à jour et déploiement logiciel.

  • Reproduire et analyser les problèmes remontés par les clients dans des environnements intégrés.

  • Analyser les défauts, mener des investigations et soutenir les actions correctives et préventives.

  • Effectuer des tests basés sur les risques liés à l'usage prévu, impact clinique et criticité du workflow.

  • Assister les distributeurs, partenaires et sites clients dans les validations.

  • Maintenir des environnements de test représentatifs des déploiements réels en santé.


Formation

  • Bachelor ou Master en :

  • Génie Biomédical

  • Informatique

  • Génie Logiciel

  • Systèmes d'information en santé

  • Discipline technique liée

jobs.title: Stage consultancy in het publieke domein
jobs.description:
Stage consultancy in het publieke domein

24-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformatie van Openbaar Bestuur | €600 | WO

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Berenschot is op zoek naar een masterstudent die stage wil lopen bij de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Heb jij affiniteit met bestuurlijke vraagstukken en interesse in het adviesvak? Vind jij het leuk om mee te draaien in adviesprojecten en heb je een sterk organisatorisch vermogen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou! Werken voor Berenschot betekent werken aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Wij helpen verschillende organisaties in het publieke domein met allerlei uitdagingen. Ook organiseren we regelmatig bijeenkomsten, kennissessies en meetings met een maatschappelijk tintje. Je leert veel over het dynamische speelveld waarin wij werken, doordat je direct meewerkt aan uitdagende opdrachten en een actieve bijdrage levert aan de genoemde activiteiten. Je komt terecht in een ambitieus en gedreven team met veel ervaring in het publieke domein. Dit team focust zich voornamelijk op strategie, samenwerking en organisatieontwikkeling in het openbaar bestuur. Zie je jezelf na de stage in het adviesvak? Dan zijn er mogelijkheden om te solliciteren op een traineeship.

Dit ga je doen

Overheden staan voor uiteenlopende uitdagingen, van de energietransitie tot het verbeteren van de woningmarkt. Berenschot helpt ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en waterschappen om deze uitdagingen aan te gaan. Als stagiair(e) draag je bij door:

  • Mee te draaien met de Gideonsbende, waar je helpt bij de organisatie van leergangen en inspiratiesessies.

  • Actief mee te werken aan opdrachten, zodat je het speelveld en de spelers binnen het publieke domein leert kennen.

  • Samen met collega-consultants naar klanten te gaan en te leren van hun vraagstukken.

  • Onderzoek te doen en vraagstukken te analyseren, ter ondersteuning van het advieswerk.

  • Leermodules en events te organiseren, waarbij je contact onderhoudt met sprekers en locaties.

Tijdens je stage word je intensief begeleid door een adviseur, zodat je je professionele vaardigheden ontwikkelt en leert hoe concepten en theorieën toegepast worden in de praktijk. Ook het uitvoeren van een afstudeeronderzoek is mogelijk. In dat geval bespreken we graag met elkaar hoe we het afstudeeronderzoek zo goed mogelijk kunnen laten aansluiten op ons advieswerk en vice versa.

Quote

"De kracht van samenwerking in het publieke domein inspireert mij dagelijks om innovatieve en waardevolle oplossingen te bieden voor maatschappelijke uitdagingen." – Senior consultant publieke sector

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega's

Je gaat werken binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur, specifiek in het team Strategie, Samenwerking en Organisatieontwikkeling. Dit team bestaat uit twintig gedreven adviseurs met specialisaties in bestuurskunde, rechten, technologie en innovatie. We houden ontwikkelingen in de maatschappij, politiek en economie nauwlettend in de gaten en schakelen direct in bij grote opgaven. We werken in wisselende teams, zodat altijd de juiste expertise beschikbaar is. Naast hard werken, wordt er veel gelachen.

Binnen Berenschot hebben we een Gideonsbende: vrije denkers en jonge mensen die evenementen organiseren die normaal niet tot stand komen. Denk aan leergangen voor bestuurders en topambtenaren met de titel ‘Taaie thema’s en duivelse dilemma’s in het openbaar bestuur’. Daarnaast organiseren we onze eigen schaduwverkiezingen (inclusief uitslagenevenement) parallel aan die van de Tweede Kamer, provincies/Waterschappen of gemeenteraden. Verder organiseren wij allerlei andere bijeenkomsten, zoals een adviesmarathon voor het oplossen van vraagstukken van kleinere maatschappelijke organisaties.


Dit neem je mee

  • Je volgt een master (technische) bestuurskunde, management van de publieke sector, politicologie, bedrijfskunde, economie, sociologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Staat jouw studierichting hier niet bij, maar heb je wel affiniteit met het openbaar bestuur en een maatschappelijke drive? Solliciteer dan ook zeker!

  • Je hebt een sterk conceptueel en analytisch vermogen, bent nieuwsgierig en staat stevig in je schoenen.

  • Je bent creatief, goed in organiseren en werkt graag in teamverband.

  • Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • Een laptop.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding gericht op jouw professionele en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Een inspirerende werkplek in Utrecht en hybride werkmogelijkheden.

  • Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Wil jij ook een trotse Berenschotter worden? Solliciteer direct! Stuur je cv en motivatie naar Mariëlle Boer. Vragen? Neem contact op met Mariëlle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10487159) of per mail ().

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Florian Rosenmöller beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Bel of WhatsApp Florian Rosenmöller via (06 30364562). of stuur een e-mail naar

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve uitkomst nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Sluit dat goed aan? Dan krijg je snel een concreet aanbod en verwelkomen we je graag in ons team als nieuwe Berenschotter!

Vooruitgang begint bij jou – waar wacht je nog op?

Following a record-breaking 2025 where we shattered revenue targets and expanded our global footprint, we are entering 2026 with even greater momentum. The primary focus of this role is to support customer expansion by partnering with Account Managers during complex renewal and upsell opportunities.
 
You will be the go-to expert for our new multi-product offering, responsible for demonstrating advanced technical value and architecting solutions that drive growth within our existing customer base.
 
This role is perfect for someone who excels in a post-sales technical environment, loves being a product authority, and thrives on building solutions that directly impact commercial success.

What will you do?

jobs.description:
FDE Data Engineer- Space (FedD141/FedD147)

EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION WILL REQUIRE U.S. CITIZENSHIP.

Role Description

This is a forward-deployed engineering role. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes: the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments. You'll help take UDS Data Capability from "deployable" to "running in production under classification." You will deploy, integrate, and operate our data stack in the mission hero's environment alongside senior engineers, then carry what you learn back into the product so the next engagement is easier.

The scope of this work varies by engagement. Some programs require standing up a governed data platform to centralize sensor or operational data from known sources, where the problem is well-defined and the priority is building and shipping. Others involve consolidating data across hundreds of interconnected government systems of record with overlapping schemas, deeply interdependent data flows, and significant architectural complexity. You should be comfortable building independently against defined problems and growing into more ambiguous, complex engagements over time.

Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero, not always on a plane. Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement calls for it: initial standup, integration work, incident response, training and knowledge transfer. The rest of the time, you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero. The role is defined by the relationship with the mission hero, not by where you sit.

You are a data engineer who can build across the breadth of a data platform (storage, ingestion, streaming, governance, and access) and deliver working solutions in constrained, mission-critical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and configure UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment. Stand up the UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required.
  • Build and support integrations with existing mission systems. Connect UDS Data Capability to legacy databases, flat-file drops, SOAP/REST endpoints, message buses, existing object storage, and identity providers (Keycloak, mission-side SSO). Prior experience integrating with these types of systems is more relevant than experience building on them.
  • Contribute to mapping complex data landscapes. Some engagements involve hundreds of interconnected systems of record with overlapping schemas and deeply interdependent data flows. You'll help trace how data moves across systems and identify dependencies alongside senior engineers and government stakeholders.
  • Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries, including ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions.
  • Implement data provenance, lineage, and governance practices. Track where data came from, how it transformed, and who can access it.
  • Operate what you deploy. Day-2 ownership includes capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Hand off to the mission hero's ops team once it's stable.
  • Generate accreditation artifacts, including STIG evidence, cATO documentation, FIPS validation notes, and policy mappings. You produce the evidence the mission hero's ISSM/ISSO needs to run this in IL4/IL5.
  • Contribute field feedback back to product and engineering. File issues, write postmortems, and surface what's working and what's breaking in the mission environment.
  • Support training and knowledge transfer. Contribute to runbooks, architecture docs, and working sessions that leave the mission hero's team self-sufficient.

Preferred Locations: Colorado Springs, CO or Florida Space Coast (Cape Canaveral / Cocoa Beach / Melbourne). Remote candidates will be considered, but local presence is strongly preferred.

Travel Expectations: Candidates based in Colorado Springs or the Florida Space Coast can expect on-site presence 1-2 days per week. Remote candidates should expect to travel to the engagement site for approximately one week every 4-6 weeks.

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Required Qualifications

Data engineering breadth

  • Unstructured data at scale. Experience storing and querying large unstructured datasets using data lake architectures. Spark experience preferred.
  • Streaming & integration. Experience with stream processing infrastructure (Kafka, Redpanda, Flink, or equivalent) and bridging data from heterogeneous sources into modern pipelines.
  • Data warehousing. Open-source data warehousing platform experience. These environments do not support proprietary platforms, so you need to be comfortable building without them.
  • Pipelines & orchestration. Airflow, Dagster, Argo Workflows, or similar. Comfort building, scheduling, monitoring, and recovering production data pipelines.
  • Data modeling & SQL. Fluent in SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for both analytical and operational workloads.

Open-source orientation. You are comfortable building on open-source tooling and contributing back to it.

What "forward-deployed" requires

  • U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance. Clearance sponsorship available for the right candidate.
  • Comfort working directly with mission heroes and government stakeholders. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort with periodic on-site work, sometimes for days at a stretch, and equal comfort working remotely.
  • Bias toward delivery. Preference for shipping a working integration over perfecting a design that hasn't met a real workload.
  • Self-direction. You will encounter environments and problems that are not yet documented and will need to work through them independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Data provenance, lineage, and governance. Experience with lineage tracking, data catalogs, provenance systems, or governance frameworks. Depth here will be weighted heavily.
  • DoD or defense program experience.
  • Active Secret clearance (or higher).
  • Lakehouse & storage: Apache Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi), object storage (Ceph/S3-compatible), Postgres (including extensions like pgvector), columnar/OLAP engines (Trino, DuckDB, ClickHouse, Spark SQL).
  • Change Data Capture: Debezium or similar CDC patterns.
  • Governance, catalog & access: REST catalogs (Iceberg REST, Polaris/Gravitino/Nessie family), ABAC/RBAC patterns, OIDC/OAuth, lineage and audit.
  • Kubernetes awareness. Deep K8s expertise is not required; general familiarity with deployments, operators, and how applications run on Kubernetes is valuable.
  • Linux fundamentals, container runtime behavior, networking, TLS, secrets management.
  • IaC (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and GitOps patterns (Flux, ArgoCD).
  • Familiarity with the CNCF ecosystem, including the distinction between foundation projects and single-vendor projects.
  • AI/ML awareness. General understanding of how data infrastructure supports model training, versioning, provenance, and AI operations.
  • Familiarity with Air Force or Space Force systems of record (e.g., MILPDS, ARMS) and how data flows between them.

You do not need to meet every preferred qualification. You do need to be credible across the core data engineering requirements.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. Head of Product Design

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude is moving fast, from product analytics to an AI-native platform with agents embedded across the product, used by over 4,700 companies. We are looking for a strong design leader with a builder mindset to lead a 15-person design team through the next phase of growth.

This is a player-coach role. You manage and grow the team. You also stay in the actual work: elevating quality through feedback, pairing with designers on the hardest UX puzzles, and asking the right questions to unlock the crux of the problem. You'll know every product surface well enough to raise its quality — even if you don't own any single one end-to-end.

Designers are embedded in autonomous pods and need to keep shipping fast. Maintaining speed without compromising on coherence and quality is the job. If that tension sounds like an exciting problem to solve rather than a contradiction to complain about, keep reading.

What you'll do

Build the team. Hire, grow, and retain a high-performing design team, identifying people who will thrive and raise the bar at Amplitude. Develop them through direct, specific feedback. Help someone who's stuck get moving again.

Set direction. Drive the design strategy for Amplitude's product suite: Core Amplitude, Statsig, and Wave (a proactive agent that helps teams build self-improving products). Help define how agents and humans work together in the same workflows.

Champion craft. Strong visual design builds trust, clarity, and delight in the era of AI. Lead by example, elevating the quality of the product through exceptional design execution.

Hold a high bar. AI makes it cheap to ship UI changes, which makes it easy for quality to erode quietly. Set a clear standard for what good looks like and enforce it without becoming an approval bottleneck.

Stay in production. You believe that “the design” is what ships. Code is the material that brings the design to life. Push on the details, the papercuts, the edge cases.

Speak for the customer. Show up in leadership conversations as the voice of the customer, pushing for solutions that genuinely serve their needs and reduce complexity.

What we're looking for

  • You've managed senior, independent IC designers and earned their respect through product and craft judgment.

  • You've shipped products that moved real customer and business metrics, fast.

  • You've created (not inherited) structure inside of a messy, high-growth organization.

  • You've shipped AI-native experiences and use AI tools in your own practice today (we'll ask what you built and what you learned).

  • Your portfolio shows both systems-level thinking and pixel-level craft.

  • Bonus: You’ve designed for both technical and non-technical users, and can hold that tension without compromising the experience for either.

  • Bonus: Experience with Analytics, Experimentation, or Developer tools.

What this is not

  • Not an executive role that manages up and delegates down. You're deep in the work.

  • Not a pure IC role. You're accountable for a team of 15.

  • Not design ops. Your job isn't to add rituals, templates, or governance.

  • Not the approval committee. Pods keep moving; you create coherence without becoming the bottleneck.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
Manager, Global Financial Reporting

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Manager, Global Financial Reporting to play a critical role in strengthening and scaling the Company’s financial reporting function as the business continues to grow and operational complexity increases. This role will support the preparation of high-quality financial statements and disclosures, drive reporting process maturity, and help build a scalable, well-controlled financial reporting environment.

This position will work cross-functionally to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent financial reporting across the organization while supporting audit execution, internal controls, and public-company readiness initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end preparation, drafting, and compilation of quarterly (Form 10-Q) and annual (Form 10-K) financial statements, including complex footnotes, disclosures, and Management’s Discussion and Analysis (MD&A).
  • Prepare consolidated and standalone financial statements and disclosures to support both global regulatory reporting and local statutory requirements.
  • Stay abreast of evolving SEC regulations, PCAOB standards, and FASB updates; evaluate their impact and update accounting and financial reporting policies accordingly.
  • Support the monthly and quarterly close processes, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely financial reporting that meets accelerated public-company timelines.
  • Support the consistent application of U.S. GAAP accounting policies across global subsidiaries through technical guidance and structured review.
  • Review significant contracts, M&A activities, and unique transactions to assess financial reporting, accounting treatment, and SEC disclosure implications.
  • Support goodwill impairment and segment reviews.
  • Act as a primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit deliverables, timelines, and the resolution of complex reporting and disclosure issues.
  • Strengthen the control environment by identifying and mitigating financial reporting risks through proactive Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) monitoring.
  • Lead financial reporting process documentation efforts (XBRL tagging review, disclosure checklists), identify control gaps, and support remediation initiatives.
  • Support the drafting and tie-out of Form 8-Ks (including earnings documentation), Proxy statements and additional filing types.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation, and standardization in financial reporting workflows to reduce close cycle times.
  • Support long-term scalability and readiness for public-company reporting requirements, ensuring reporting infrastructure keeps pace with company growth.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; CPA license required; Big-4 preferred.
  • Experience: 7+ years of progressive experience with financial reporting experience at a publicly traded company. Cash Flow and EPS experience is highly preferred.
  • SEC Technical Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience preparing and reviewing Form 10-K and Form 10-Q filings, with a strong command of SEC rules, regulations, and U.S. GAAP.
  • Systems & Tools: Familiarity with modern financial reporting and SEC filing software (e.g., Workiva, ActiveDisclosure) and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP) is highly preferred.
  • Execution Skills: Highly self-directed and accountable, with a proven ability to deliver against strict SEC timelines and competing demands.
  • Soft Skills: A collaborative critical thinker who can work effectively across functions and levels, foresee potential reporting obstacles, and propose alternative, compliant approaches.

Benefits

At ŌURA, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at ŌURA has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health and add to our benefits!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave
  • Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internal Audit (All Levels)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Internal Audit (All Levels)

About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

About the Role

You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners.

Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. We're hiring across all levels and will calibrate during interviews based on scope and demonstrated experience.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agent-driven experiences for SOX control testing, deciding where autonomy makes sense and where the auditor stays in the loop

  • Own complex, end-to-end workstreams across the full stack

  • Make long agentic runs trustworthy: improve reliability, repeatability, performance, and observability so the same evidence produces the same defensible conclusion every time

  • Turn agent output into finished audit deliverables, including structured workpapers that adapt to whatever template a firm brings

  • Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas

  • Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and SOX subject matter experts to work through difficult domain problems

  • Help shape technical direction and contribute to how the team thinks about agentic systems, AI tooling, and engineering best practices

Who You Are (All Levels)

  • A strong full-stack engineer who writes code every day and wants to continue doing so

  • You've built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes. You know what breaks when real users and real documents hit an agent

  • Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you figure things out as you go

  • Energized by 0→1 work: you'd rather define the problem than inherit a spec

  • High degree of ownership; you don't wait to be told what to do

  • A genuine team player across the organization, not just within engineering. You'll work directly with PM, design, domain experts, and customer-facing teams, and you treat that as the best part of the job

  • Able to pick up complex domain concepts quickly. You don't need to know SOX or internal controls, but you're the kind of person who can internalize it fast

  • Already using AI coding tools in your workflow and curious about where agentic approaches create real leverage

Higher-Level Responsibilities

At the Senior level, you may:

  • Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health

  • Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs

  • Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., agent orchestration, evaluation and quality, document processing, frontend architecture)

  • Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team

At the Staff level, you may:

  • Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture

  • Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design

  • Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions

Experience

Must-have:

  • Shipped LLM-backed product features to production against real users

  • Comfortable full-stack, with enough backend depth to work in agent orchestration

  • Autonomy working from an ambiguous spec

  • A collaborative mindset with an ability to work across PM, design, and domain experts

  • Willingness to develop an Applied AI skillset including writing evals, using LLM observability tools, and being thoughtful about quality

Nice-to-have:

  • Startup experience, as a founder or as an early engineer

  • A track record of 0→1 projects you took from nothing to something people use

  • Experience working directly with customers, and comfort being in the room when they use what you built

  • Experience in internal audit, SOX, financial services, accounting, or compliance

  • Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, and Temporal

  • Experience with document processing, PDF/Excel manipulation, or evaluation frameworks for model output

Not a fit if:

  • You’re not interested in deeply learning about Agents

  • You’ve never built a product to scale

  • You need a fully specified ticket to start

  • You'd rather not be in the room with customers and domain experts

What Should Excite You

  • 0→1 on the biggest bet: You're building the agent and the product from scratch, on the ground floor of where the company is going

  • Real audit stakes: Your work directly affects what firms put in front of their clients, and what a reviewer is willing to sign

  • Customer proximity: Design-partner firms and an embedded SOX expert use what you ship within days of it landing

  • High trust, high autonomy: You're given ambiguous problems and trusted to define the plan

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with equity

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

  • Flexible time off and work schedules

  • Technology reimbursements

  • 401(k) plan

  • Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S.

  • Wellness benefits starting on your first day

Our Values

  • Fearless — Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls

  • Fast — Launch fast with excellence; iterate to perfection

  • Lovable — Deliver happiness and 11-star experiences

  • Owners — Execute and run the business with ownership

  • Win-win — Create mutual value and earn trust for life

  • Inclusive — Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams

jobs.title: Organic & AI Search Manager
jobs.description:
Organic & AI Search Manager

What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The Role:

The way people find information is changing. Search now includes AI-generated answers, large language model (LLM) citations, and zero-click journeys. People often get an answer without visiting a website, so how a brand is understood and cited matters as much as where its pages rank.

We’re looking for an Organic & AI Search Manager to help Paddle show up well in those answers. You’ll shape how Paddle is understood, cited, and recommended by both people and machines. Ranking pages is part of that. Being cited and recommended is the rest. You’ll work across organic strategy, AI discoverability, and content, partnering closely with our Brand, product marketing (PMM), and Growth teams so the content we create is easy to find, trust, and surface in AI-generated answers.

Reporting to the Head of Web, you’ll connect the people who create content with the changing landscape of organic and AI-powered discovery. You’ll turn insight into strategy, and strategy into decisions.

You’ll also help move the work forward. You’ll help shape new content, and you’ll steer business-as-usual (BAU) updates, refreshes, and improvements that strengthen organic visibility, AI discoverability, and performance. Where it helps, you’ll draft first versions for review, using AI to speed that up. This is a broad role for someone who can move between spotting opportunities, making recommendations, and moving the work forward.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own Paddle’s organic and AI discoverability strategy, from brand awareness to category-level consideration, so we’re visible wherever our audience looks for answers

  • Audit our presence across traditional search, AI-generated responses, and LLM citation patterns, then build and maintain a prioritized roadmap based on the gaps

  • Turn organic and AI visibility data into clear content decisions for Brand, PMM, and Growth

  • Work with Creative, Social, and PR within Brand to structure, frame, and distribute content so search engines and LLMs can find and use it

  • Work with PMM to align messaging, terminology, and the topics we want Paddle to be known for, so we’re represented consistently wherever people look

  • Steer BAU content updates and refreshes, drafting first versions for review with the help of AI, and bring SEO and AEO input to new content

  • Define and track the metrics that show real discoverability (AI citation share, share of voice in LLM outputs, and organic visibility trends), and use them to create accountability across content functions

  • Link organic and AI visibility to commercial goals, and influence pipeline through the content and topics we prioritise

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have a strong foundation in search engine optimisation (SEO), across technical, on-page, and off-page work, and are building expertise in AI and LLM discoverability, answer engine optimisation (AEO), or generative engine optimisation (GEO)

  • Understand how LLMs surface, cite, and recommend content, and have an informed view on how brands can influence that

  • Have experience working cross-functionally with content, brand, or product marketing teams, and have shaped and influenced how they work

  • Can steer content updates and produce a first draft for review, using AI to help

  • Are comfortable turning complex organic data and trends into clear direction for non-specialist stakeholders

  • Can connect organic performance to commercial outcomes such as pipeline, and explain the link to stakeholders

  • Can balance long-term strategic thinking with moving quickly and testing your hypotheses

  • Are curious about how information discovery is changing and have strong opinions on where it’s heading

 

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

jobs.title: Director, SE
jobs.description:
Director, SE

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

Role Overview

Join Delinea as Sales Engineering Director for Northern Europe and shape how the world’s leading identity security platform is positioned and demonstrated to enterprise customers. In this role, you will build and mentor a team of 5-7 Sales Engineers across the region, develop technical strategy, and directly influence Delinea’s competitive positioning in the market. This role is based in the UK.

You will report to the EMEA VP of Sales Engineering, work directly with regional leadership, and own the technical narrative for one of Delinea’s most strategic markets. This is an opportunity to lead at scale, invest in people, and help organisations embrace Zero Standing Privilege.
