jobs.title: Head of Product, Growth + Monetization
jobs.description:
Head of Product, Growth + Monetization

Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Your impact

Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. More than 10,000 businesses use us, and a remarkable share of them arrived because someone they respect recommended us. That trust is also why customers stay and grow with us once they're in the door.

Growth is how more of the people who show up turn into teams who can't imagine working without Help Scout — and how customers who already love one part of the product find their way into what's next. As Head of Product, Growth & Monetization, you'll be directly accountable for both sides of that story: the core funnel that turns a signup into a paying customer, and the in-app motion that turns a paying customer into an expanding one.

About the role

  • Own the growth roadmap. You'll partner with Design and Engineering, but you’ll own the vision, roadmap, and execution for the Growth team. That starts with sharpening the core funnel: signup, onboarding, trial-to-paid conversion, and the activation moments that turn a trial into a team that can't imagine working without Help Scout.

  • Run growth experimentation across the org. Build and run an experimentation practice spanning two swim lanes: new business (signup through trial-to-paid) and expansion (getting existing customers to experience and purchase Agent, Copilot, and Signal products). The expansion lane means designing and running experiments inside product lines you don't own, in partnership with the other product leaders who do.

  • Evolve Help Scout's monetization strategy. Own the overarching pricing and packaging framework across the portfolio. Each Head of Product still owns pricing and packaging execution for their own line — your job is the cross-product throughline and the judgment to know when to weigh in.

  • Build growth infrastructure other teams can use. Create the growth model, experiment standards, and playbooks that let teams across the company ship growth work with confidence, without routing every decision through you.

  • Lead as a player/coach. Do the strategic work yourself today, and hire and manage a team of PMs as the group grows. You're accountable for the group's revenue results, not just its roadmap execution.

  • Partner across the customer lifecycle. Work with go-to-market so the growth motion is coherent from first touch through expansion, and spend real time with customers and in the data to keep that motion grounded in what's actually true.

About you

  • You've spent 5+ years leading growth in B2B SaaS with a free-trial or freemium motion, and you have a concrete story of moving a product line's revenue or adoption.

  • You're hands-on with experimentation. You define your own metrics, design your own tests, and you're honest about when a result is signal versus noise.

  • You think in outcomes, not features, and you build systems and playbooks that make everyone around you faster, not just wins that end with you.

  • You can design an outcome-based pricing framework and explain its tradeoffs, and you understand the difference between owning strategy and owning someone else's execution.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold an architecture conversation and push back credibly on an engineering estimate, and you understand how AI and agentic product features actually fail, not just how they work when they work.

  • You lead through influence as much as authority. Your impact here comes from getting peer product teams to want to run your experiments with you.

  • You've directly managed people before. You'll hire and coach a team of PMs as this group grows.

  • You're an excellent writer who makes your thinking visible in one-pagers and briefs that move decisions forward, and you're genuinely fluent with AI tools for research synthesis, strategy testing, and rapid prototyping.

Who you'll work with

  • Chief Product Officer. You report to the CPO and partner closely with them on strategy and monetization.

  • Head of Product, Conversations. You partner on expansion experiments and the monetization framework for Inbox and Copilot.

  • Head of Product, Intelligence. You partner on expansion experiments and the monetization framework for Agent and Signal.

  • Marketing leadership. You align the growth motion with campaigns, messaging, and pricing/packaging changes.

  • Sales & Customer Success leadership. You keep the growth motion coherent across the full customer lifecycle, from trial through expansion and renewal.

  • Growth PMs. As the group grows, a small team of PMs may report to you.

Note: This role is open to US-based applicants only.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. XYZ works across the UK, US and Europe with major clients and construction companies to deliver large-scale projects.

──────────────────────────────

This role sits within the Production team at our NPI facility in Reading, Berkshire, reporting to the Procurement Manager and on-site at least three days per week.

You will be the internal owner of the business systems that production, quality, procurement and logistics run on, with our ERP at the centre.

You'll make our ERP the single system of record for stock, BOMs, builds and serial-level traceability. The systems you build must scale with the business: what is built now must support materially higher volumes, more products and more people, without adding headcount or manual workarounds.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Own our ERP end to end: requirements, configuration, data quality, testing, releases and ongoing improvement.

• Map how the business works today across goods-in, stores, build, test, despatch and returns; define the target process and data model and hold the line on requirements as the system evolves.

• Own purchasing, supplier and item-master data the Procurement function depends on; own integrations and data flows between ERP, finance, CRM and support systems, including returns (RMA) workflows.

• Implement serial-level traceability so component and build history is queryable for containment, warranty and field-failure investigation; own engineering change control and quality records under ISO 9001.

• Build and maintain the production reporting pack, yield, scrap, rework, throughput, stock accuracy and on-time despatch, turning data into insight the team can act on.

• Identify and deliver process automation and system improvement opportunities as production scales, eliminating manual re-keying, paper records and offline spreadsheets.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

  • Extensive experience with Odoo.

  • Demonstrable experience implementing or migrating an ERP or MRP system in a manufacturing environment, ideally as the internal owner rather than an external consultant.

  • Strong understanding of manufacturing data structures: item masters, BOMs, routings, work orders, serialisation and lot control.

  • Data migration experience including extraction, cleansing, mapping and reconciliation.

  • Advanced Excel essential; SQL, Power BI or equivalent desirable. Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• Requirements gathering and process mapping capability, with the discipline to document thoroughly rather than work from memory.

• Experience of systems integration and API-based data flows.

• Understanding of ISO 9001 documented information and traceability requirements; exposure to NCR, root cause analysis and corrective action processes.

• A track record of identifying and delivering practical process improvements, with the benefit clearly evidenced.

• Self-directed and comfortable owning a programme with senior sponsorship.

• Scripting or automation capability (Python, Power Automate or similar) — desirable.

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

• 🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

• 🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

• 🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance

• 🪙 Annual salary reviews

• 🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

• 🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

jobs.description:
Creative eLearning Developer

Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, J-1, etc

Your Role:

The Creative eLearning Developer designs and builds interactive training services, offering collateral and enablement content for the Services Portfolio by combining three capabilities in one role: multimedia/video design, graphic design, and technical writing. This role turns technical subject matter into polished, field-ready courses, videos, and collateral for websites, presentations, classrooms, and e-learning platforms - owning a deliverable from storyboard through final published, LMS-ready package.

This is a “creative” eLearning Developer specifically: unlike a standard eLearning Developer who authors courses from assets supplied by others, this role also creates the graphic and multimedia assets themselves - 2-D/3-D graphics, video animation, and course visuals, in addition to authoring interactive modules in tools like Articulate Storyline or Rise 360 and writing the scripts, captions, and course copy that tie a deliverable together. The role also manages one or more supporting processes for the team (e.g., video mastering, templates, or SCORM packaging standards), working largely self-directed with minimal supervision and reporting status to leadership at regular intervals.

Your Opportunity:

Multimedia & Video Design:

  • Video & Audio Editing: Edit video and audio into the final training, services and marketing deliverables.
  • Storyboard Translation: Translate storyboards into technical infographics and animated sequences.
  • 3-D & Motion Assets: Create line art, 2-D graphics, 3-D imaging, and video animation for course and presentation content.

Graphic Design & Brand Hub:

  • Template & Style Systems: Create, maintain, and utilize templates for presentations, documents, and animations using a variety of development tools.
  • Brand & Style Guides: Contribute to creating style guides for deliverables, ensuring visual and written consistency across the portfolio.
  • Visual Layout: Design presentation layouts and visual assets that translate technical information into a clear visual story.
  • Brand Evolution Support: Support the Senior Manager, Services Portfolio Production, in executing the corporate “house style” overhaul across all One Tenable, Prime assets, including the Tier 1/2 rebrand timeline.
  • Creative Request Hub: Act as a direct creative design point of contact for the Senior Director and leadership — turning around presentations, graphics, and one-off collateral on request — with strict adherence to brand guidelines.
  • Brand Guideline Stewardship: Maintain and enforce brand standards (logo usage, typography, color, iconography) across all portfolio deliverables, and flag or correct off-brand assets in circulation.

Technical Writing & Content Development:

  • Script & Course Copy: Write and edit scripts, voiceover text, captions, and on-screen callouts, maintaining a consistent voice across written and visual content.
  • Documentation: Maintain technical and course documentation to support the assets you build.
  • Content Evaluation: Evaluate existing visual and written content and recommend improvements for clarity and engagement.

eLearning Authoring & Publishing:

  • Course Authoring: Build interactive learning modules — branching scenarios, quizzes, and simulations — using tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise 360, or Adobe Captivate.
  • Packaging & LMS Publishing: Package courses to SCORM/xAPI standards, publish to the LMS, and test for compatibility and learner tracking.
  • Accessibility: Apply accessibility standards (e.g., Section 508) to eLearning content.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery:

  • Requirements Gathering: Meet with stakeholders to gather requirements and develop design plans.
  • Iterative Feedback: Perform edits based on feedback from Solution Architects, peers, and leadership.
  • Deadline Management: Create deliverables within time constraints to meet project deadlines.
  • Independent Execution: Perform tasks with minimal supervision, managing one or more supporting processes (e.g., video mastering, templates, SCORM packaging standards) end-to-end.

Team Leadership & Mentorship:

  • Mentorship: Mentor and develop less experienced designers, sharing craft and process knowledge across the production team.

What You'll Need:

  • Minimum 5 years of eLearning development, multimedia, or graphic/video design experience in a professional setting.
  • Comfortable writing and maintaining technical/course documentation, scripts, and captions for course and video deliverables.
  • Familiarity with the full product delivery life cycle: requirements analysis, design, testing, implementation.
  • B.A./B.S. in graphic design, instructional design, educational technology, or a related field, or comparable experience.
  • Proficiency with Articulate Storyline and/or Rise 360 (or Adobe Captivate), plus Adobe Creative Cloud and Camtasia.
  • Strong presentation design skills (PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Keynote) for fast-turnaround, executive-ready decks in addition to core Adobe Creative Cloud work.
  • Experience building or maintaining a brand guideline system (logo, typography, color, iconography) at an organizational level.
  • Working knowledge of SCORM/xAPI packaging and LMS publishing; awareness of accessibility standards such as Section 508.
  • Working knowledge of Instructional Design frameworks (e.g., ADDIE).
  • Experience or knowledge of Tenable products; familiarity with network architecture and Tenable cybersecurity practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong initiative and the ability to work remotely, both self-directed and as part of a geographically distributed team.
  • This role may require the ability to work in a hybrid/on-site capacity at our headquarters in Columbia MD or Boston MA. This position is US-based only.
  • Ability to work remotely in a self-directed manner
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods
  • Physically able to participate in training sessions, presentations and meetings
  • Some Tenable office travel may be required
